title: Business and Global Finance Summer Camp in London
raw_title: Business and Global Finance Summer Camp in London
subject: Business and Global Finance
description_short: Discover the world of finance this summer in London! Learn about business, investments and entrepreneurship. Gain practical skills & make lifelong connections.
description_full: Discover the world of finance this summer in London! Learn about business, investments and entrepreneurship. Gain practical skills & make lifelong connections.

curriculum_sections.body: Learning outcomes By the end of the course, students will: Develop English language fluency through meaningful, context-rich learning experiencesUnderstand core principles of financial markets, business models and corporate financeApply concepts of entrepreneurship, innovation and risk management to real-world case studiesGain insight into building and scaling a startup, including operations, sales and marketingStrengthen critical thinking, teamwork and decision-making skills for future careersBuild a portfolio of business and finance projects to support university applications Capstone Industry Project The project is developed and delivered by business education experts. You will apply your newly developed language, skills and knowledge by stepping into the role of investors in a "Shark Tank"-style pitch session, where you will critically appraise business ideas and products presented by industry professionals. Drawing on your knowledge from the subject studies programme, you will analyse these pitches from a financial perspective, using business terminology and trawling through the business balance sheets! Armed with "virtual money," you will engage in negotiation and bargaining, deciding which ventures to invest in while applying your understanding of financial metrics and business strategies in a realistic and interactive setting. Download our Capstone Overview for more details. Activities and Excursions The addition of an exciting and varied activity and excursion programmes embedded in the timetable, ensures students will have a well-rounded and powerful two weeks studying on the Young Professionals Business and Global Finance course. subject: Film & Digital Communication
description_short: A two-week Film & Digital Communication summer course in London for young professionals. Build filmmaking skills, improve English and gain industry insight.
description_full: A two-week Film & Digital Communication summer course in London for young professionals. Build filmmaking skills, improve English and gain industry insight.

curriculum_sections.body: What this course prepares you for By the end of the programme, students will have: A completed short film created as part of a teamStrong visual storytelling and digital communication skillsIncreased confidence presenting ideas and creative workExperience of professional creative processesInsight into careers across film, media and beyondA certificate of participation from London Film School. Capstone Industry Project Students will work in small production teams to develop, shoot and present a short film in response to a real-world creative brief. Acting as a professional filmmaking unit, each group will take a project from concept through to final screening, learning how ideas are shaped, communicated and refined in a video-first world. description_full: Cambridge summer programs are an opportunity to explore the world of architecture in the inspiring city of Cambridge, home to some of the most iconic architectural landmarks in the UK. Immerse Education’s Architecture summer school in Cambridge offers participants aged 13-15 an opportunity to examine Cambridge’s built environment, study architectural design principles, explore innovative building techniques and work on design projects. Explore the world of architecture in the inspiring city of Cambridge, home to some of the most iconic architectural landmarks in the UK. Immerse Education’s Architecture summer school in Cambridge offers participants aged 16-18 an opportunity to analyse the city’s built environment, develop portfolio-ready studio work, explore sustainable and structural design and refine proposals using industry-standard tools. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. What city would be a better place to discover the exciting world of architecture other than the historic city of Cambridge? Immerse Education’s Architecture summer school in Cambridge provides students aged 13–18 with the chance to learn about design, creativity and planning in one of the UK’s most iconic academic settings. Whether you’re just starting out or ready to explore advanced topics, this program is the perfect way to learn about architecture while enjoying the architecture of Cambridge University as its resident. Through hands-on projects, expert guidance and a blend of classroom and practical experiences, you’ll gain knowledge, skills and memories to last a lifetime and become a solid ground for your future career.

curriculum_sections.title: In-depth academic sessions
curriculum_sections.body: Immerse yourself in rigorous academic sessions, led by expert tutors from prestigious universities. These classes go beyond standard curricula, challenging participants to explore complex concepts, engage in critical analysis and develop a sophisticated understanding that will add weight to any university application.

curriculum_sections.body: Experience personalised academic guidance from tutors who adapt their teaching to your unique learning style and goals. These individual sessions provide the perfect setting to clarify complex ideas, explore advanced topics of interest and receive focused feedback that will help you grow academically.

curriculum_sections.title: Certificate of achievement
curriculum_sections.body: Earn a respected certificate that recognises your academic accomplishments and commitment to life-long curiosity. This valuable recognition celebrates your dedication and intellectual development, while providing compelling evidence of your readiness for advanced study in the competitive world of university applications.

title: Artificial Intelligence in Cambridge
raw_title: Artificial Intelligence Cambridge Summer Program: Real‑World Skills
subject: Artificial Intelligence
description_short: In this hub of innovation, participants master using of AI in different contexts for future education and career benefits.
description_full: Cambridge has long been a hub of cutting-edge research and digital innovation. In our Artificial Intelligence Cambridge summer school, students aged 15–18 explore the foundations of machine learning, ethics and real-world applications. It’s a Cambridge summer program that provides insight into the most transformative technology of our time in one of the world’s most intellectually dynamic cities. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Our Artificial Intelligence summer programme is designed for students aged 15-18 who are curious about how intelligent systems are shaping the future. Surrounded by a legacy of discovery and a culture of innovation, you’ll dive into the fundamentals of machine learning, robotics and algorithmic thinking in the context of Cambridge’s thriving startup landscape. The historic setting of Cambridge sets the stage for deep exploration, whilst the daring companies innovating in the city spark the imagination. Through hands-on projects, practical simulations and discussions led by expert mentors and local experts, you’ll develop real-world skills and a strong foundational understanding of AI. Whether you aspire to study computer science at university or hope to launch a career in emerging tech, this is your opportunity to gain insights and experience in one of the most exciting fields of the future, all while living and learning in one of the world’s most inspiring academic cities.

curriculum_sections.title: Project-based learning sessions
curriculum_sections.body: In these two-hour sessions, Expert Tutors from the industry guide participants through hands-on tasks that provide practical, real-world experience. Each session is designed to equip students with essential skills directly relevant to their chosen field, allowing them to apply theoretical knowledge to practical tasks and gain confidence in industry-related skills.

curriculum_sections.title: Career Skills Sessions
curriculum_sections.body: These sessions cover vital areas such as career exploration, job search strategies, evaluating potential employers, crafting future CVs and writing impactful cover letters. Each session aims to build a comprehensive skill set that supports participants on their professional journey.

curriculum_sections.title: Expert Workshops
curriculum_sections.body: Led by Expert Tutors, these workshops provide insights into various career paths and industry practices. Participants benefit from the experiences shared by professionals, gaining practical knowledge and understanding of the skills required in their fields of interest. These sessions are designed to bridge the gap between academic learning and professional application, equipping students with tools essential for future success.

curriculum_sections.title: 1:1 Coaching Sessions
curriculum_sections.body: Each week, participants receive one-on-one sessions with their dedicated Expert Industry Tutor. These tailored meetings are designed to provide individual feedback and career-focused support, ensuring that each student receives guidance suited to their career planning, industry interests and personal development goals.

curriculum_sections.title: Work on Personal Project
curriculum_sections.body: Throughout the programme, students engage in individual projects that allow them to apply acquired knowledge and skills to real-world scenarios and work on their future career plans. This hands-on approach fosters critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, culminating in a comprehensive project presentation to industry experts.

curriculum_sections.title: Industry Visits
curriculum_sections.body: Industry visits offer participants firsthand exposure to their field of interest. Through visits to leading local companies and on-site guest speaker sessions, students gain invaluable insights into the industry landscape and have the opportunity to network with professionals, helping them understand potential career paths.

description_short: In historic Cambridge, explore entrepreneurship, leadership and marketing. Work through real business case studies and build your own strategic plan with expert support.
description_full: Cambridge summer programs benefit from the city’s status as an entrepreneurial hub is bolstered by its vibrant tech ecosystem and world-class research. On our Business Management summer school in Cambridge, students aged 15–18 are guided through core concepts of leadership, marketing and strategic thinking, with practical insights from one of the world’s most intellectually dynamic cities. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Cambridge has long been a centre for innovation and enterprise, making it the ideal setting for young aspiring entrepreneurs. The Business Management summer programme is tailored for students aged 15-18 who are eager to explore the mechanics of business success, from strategy and finance to leadership and innovation. You’ll learn in an environment that breeds start-ups, tech giants and influential thinkers alike. Guided by experienced tutors, you’ll complete industry visits, take on real-world challenges and work in teams to pitch ideas, evaluate markets and think creatively under pressure. Witnessing the enterprise woven into the city will inspire your ambition and refine your vision. Whether you’re dreaming of building your own business, heading to a prestigious institution like Cambridge’s Judge Business School, or developing a future in management, this programme gives you the confidence, skills and insight to take your first steps into the world of commerce with purpose and direction.

description_short: This creative industries programme in inspiring Cambridge blends design thinking, storytelling and branding with studio visits, live briefs and hands-on project work.
description_full: Whether you dream of launching a fashion label, working behind the scenes of a theatre production, or curating immersive digital experiences, our unique Cambridge University-hosted summer school provides the perfect creative springboard. These Cambridge summer courses for 15–18-year-olds explores media, storytelling and design in a city steeped in cultural history. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Cambridge has always been a city where science and the arts intersect – and our Creative Industries summer programme is a chance to explore where design, storytelling and media come together in fresh and exciting ways. Designed for students aged 15-18, this immersive experience covers everything from branding and digital media to production and design thinking. You’ll develop creative and commercial awareness through hands-on projects and collaborative workshops led by experienced professionals. The programme invites you to think not only about how content is made, but how it resonates, engages and connects. In Cambridge’s intellectually charged atmosphere, you’ll discover how creative ideas become real-world impact and gain tools that will serve you in industries from fashion and film to advertising and tech. Whether you’re considering a future in design, content creation, or brand storytelling, this course helps you explore your potential in one of the world’s most fertile creative environments.

curriculum_sections.title: Project-based learning sessions
curriculum_sections.body: In these two-hour sessions, Expert Tutors from the industry guide participants through hands-on tasks that provide practical, real-world experience. Each session is designed to equip students with essential skills directly relevant to their chosen field, allowing them to apply theoretical knowledge to practical tasks and gain confidence in industry-related skills.

curriculum_sections.title: Career Skills Sessions
curriculum_sections.body: These sessions cover vital areas such as career exploration, job search strategies, evaluating potential employers, crafting future CVs and writing impactful cover letters. Each session aims to build a comprehensive skill set that supports participants on their professional journey.

curriculum_sections.title: Expert Workshops
curriculum_sections.body: Led by Expert Tutors, these workshops provide insights into various career paths and industry practices. Participants benefit from the experiences shared by professionals, gaining practical knowledge and understanding of the skills required in their fields of interest. These sessions are designed to bridge the gap between academic learning and professional application, equipping students with tools essential for future success.

curriculum_sections.title: 1:1 Coaching Sessions
curriculum_sections.body: Each week, participants receive one-on-one sessions with their dedicated Expert Industry Tutor. These tailored meetings are designed to provide individual feedback and career-focused support, ensuring that each student receives guidance suited to their career planning, industry interests and personal development goals.

curriculum_sections.title: Work on Personal Project
curriculum_sections.body: Throughout the programme, students engage in individual projects that allow them to apply acquired knowledge and skills to real-world scenarios and work on their future career plans. This hands-on approach fosters critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, culminating in a comprehensive project presentation to industry experts.

curriculum_sections.title: Industry Visits
curriculum_sections.body: Industry visits offer participants firsthand exposure to their field of interest. Through visits to leading local companies and on-site guest speaker sessions, students gain invaluable insights into the industry landscape and have the opportunity to network with professionals, helping them understand potential career paths.

We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Cambridge has played a key role in shaping the world of technology for centuries. Our Engineering summer programme, created for students aged 15-18, places you at the heart of this tradition of innovation. You’ll tackle challenges that reflect real-world problems, visit engineering companies shaping the technological landscape, build prototypes and explore principles from mechanical systems to sustainable design. With expert tutelage and a highly interactive format, this course is all about learning by doing – engaging with big ideas and complex theory while honing practical skills. You’ll also reflect on the ethical and societal impact of engineering, preparing you to think beyond the technical to the potential. Being in Cambridge means learning in a city where discovery is woven into the culture – and one that has more than its fair share of start-ups. Whether you’re hoping to study engineering at university or just starting to explore the field, this programme will help you gain the confidence to pursue your next steps.

description_short: In historic Cambridge, explore real legal challenges through case analysis, debates, ethics workshops and industry visits that reveal how law shapes society.
description_full: In a city that is both a historic authority and a modern innovator in legal thought, our Law Cambridge summer school places students aged 15–18 in mock courtrooms, law firm visits and ethical debates. This Cambridge summer program provides a rigorous and rewarding introduction to how laws and lawyers shape society – and what it takes to stand out in a competitive, ever-evolving field. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Step into Cambridge – a city shaped by centuries of legal tradition and practice. Our Law summer programme is for students aged 15-18 who are fascinated by justice, advocacy and how the law shapes our society. You’ll learn about key areas including criminal law, human rights and international law, while gaining practical experience through law firm visits, case analysis, debate and simulated legal proceedings. Through workshops and discussions led by legal scholars and practitioners, you’ll build a foundation in legal reasoning and argumentation, as well as insight into careers within legal bodies ranging from governmental organisations to commercial firms. Whether you’re considering a future as a barrister, solicitor, policymaker, or simply want to explore the world of law more deeply, a law summer programme in Cambridge helps you take your first step into the legal world with clarity and confidence.

title: Medicine in Cambridge
raw_title: Medicine Cambridge Summer Programs: University-Level Exploration
subject: Medicine
description_short: Participants will explore the realm of medical science and anatomy, acquiring valuable and practical insights into the intricacies of healthcare.
description_full: Explore the world of medicine on our summer school in Cambridge, a city known for its cutting-edge medical research and discoveries. Participants aged 13-15 on our Cambridge summer programs will actively explore medical specialities, gaining practical experience and insights through hands-on application of healthcare practices. Explore the world of medicine on our summer school in Cambridge, a city known for its cutting-edge medical research and discoveries. Participants aged 16-18 on our Cambridge summer programs will dive deep into medical science and anatomy, acquiring valuable and practical insights into the intricacies of healthcare. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Explore the fascinating world of medicine this summer in Cambridge, a city renowned for scientific discovery and medical innovation. Immerse Education’s Cambridge medicine summer school offers two carefully designed programmes for students who want to understand what studying medicine is really like. For students aged 13–15, the course introduces the foundations of human anatomy, healthcare and medical sciences. You’ll explore how the body works, examine real medical challenges and gain insight into the role medicine plays in everyday life. For students aged 16–18, our medical course in Cambridge allows you to engage with more advanced topics such as neuroscience, patient care, epidemiology and modern medical science. Through case-based learning and practical discussion, you’ll begin to think and work the way medical students do at university. Both Cambridge medicine programmes are hands-on, academically rigorous and designed to build clarity and confidence. Whether you’re exploring an early interest or preparing for a future application to medicine, this is where serious curiosity turns into informed ambition.

curriculum_sections.title: In-depth academic sessions
curriculum_sections.body: Immerse yourself in rigorous academic sessions, led by expert tutors from prestigious universities. These classes go beyond standard curricula, challenging participants to explore complex concepts, engage in critical analysis and develop a sophisticated understanding that will add weight to any university application.

curriculum_sections.title: Personal research project
curriculum_sections.body: You’ll have the opportunity to develop your academic identity through a self-directed research project tailored to the subject you’re passionate about. With guidance from your tutor, you’ll craft original research questions, apply university-level methods and create meaningful work that showcases your curiosity to university admissions teams.

curriculum_sections.title: 1-on-1 tutoring
curriculum_sections.body: Experience personalised academic guidance from tutors who adapt their teaching to your unique learning style and goals. These individual sessions provide the perfect setting to clarify complex ideas, explore advanced topics of interest and receive focused feedback that will help you grow academically.

curriculum_sections.title: Certificate of achievement
curriculum_sections.body: Earn a respected certificate that recognises your academic accomplishments and commitment to life-long curiosity. This valuable recognition celebrates your dedication and intellectual development, while providing compelling evidence of your readiness for advanced study in the competitive world of university applications.

title: Medicine in Cambridge
raw_title: Medicine Cambridge Summer Courses: Real‑World Skills
subject: Medicine
description_short: In the context of a global business hub, participants will amass the theoretical knowledge needed to effectively analyse and improve a business’s performance.
description_full: Explore the medical sciences in the city that’s been home to some of the world’s most important medical breakthroughs – from the discovery of DNA’s structure to advances in stem cell research – with Immerse’s Cambridge University-hosted summer school. Students aged 15–18 on our Cambridge summer courses enjoy visits to clinical settings in an academically rich and deeply inspiring environment. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Cambridge is a global centre for medical research and healthcare innovation – the ideal place to begin your journey into the world of medicine. Designed for students aged 15-18, our Medicine summer programme introduces you to human anatomy, diagnostics, ethics and clinical skills through a blend of hands-on practicals in clinical settings and interactive, skill-based workshops in the classroom. You’ll learn from experienced medical professionals who will guide you through real-world case studies and help you understand what a career in healthcare truly involves. As you explore topics like public health, patient communication and the diagnostic process, you’ll also reflect on the values and challenges that underpin medical practice today. The academic atmosphere of Cambridge will inspire and challenge you, giving you a strong foundation in ethical reasoning and biomedical knowledge. This programme is your chance to engage deeply with medicine in a city known for shaping future doctors and scientists.

curriculum_sections.title: Project-based learning sessions
curriculum_sections.body: In these two-hour sessions, Expert Tutors from the industry guide participants through hands-on tasks that provide practical, real-world experience. Each session is designed to equip students with essential skills directly relevant to their chosen field, allowing them to apply theoretical knowledge to practical tasks and gain confidence in industry-related skills.

curriculum_sections.title: Career Skills Sessions
curriculum_sections.body: These sessions cover vital areas such as career exploration, job search strategies, evaluating potential employers, crafting future CVs and writing impactful cover letters. Each session aims to build a comprehensive skill set that supports participants on their professional journey.

curriculum_sections.title: Expert Workshops
curriculum_sections.body: Led by Expert Tutors, these workshops provide insights into various career paths and industry practices. Participants benefit from the experiences shared by professionals, gaining practical knowledge and understanding of the skills required in their fields of interest. These sessions are designed to bridge the gap between academic learning and professional application, equipping students with tools essential for future success.

curriculum_sections.title: 1:1 Coaching Sessions
curriculum_sections.body: Each week, participants receive one-on-one sessions with their dedicated Expert Industry Tutor. These tailored meetings are designed to provide individual feedback and career-focused support, ensuring that each student receives guidance suited to their career planning, industry interests and personal development goals.

curriculum_sections.title: Work on Personal Project
curriculum_sections.body: Throughout the programme, students engage in individual projects that allow them to apply acquired knowledge and skills to real-world scenarios and work on their future career plans. This hands-on approach fosters critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, culminating in a comprehensive project presentation to industry experts.

curriculum_sections.title: Industry Visits
curriculum_sections.body: Industry visits offer participants firsthand exposure to their field of interest. Through visits to leading local companies and on-site guest speaker sessions, students gain invaluable insights into the industry landscape and have the opportunity to network with professionals, helping them understand potential career paths.

title: Creative Industries in London
raw_title: Creative Industries Summer Programme in London
subject: Creative Industries
description_short: In creative London, explore branding, visual storytelling and trend analysis. Build your portfolio through real-world projects, studio visits and expert-led workshops.
description_full: From fashion houses to live music venues, London is the beating heart of global culture. This programme gives 15–18-year-olds an insider’s look into how projects come to life through diverse visits to industry-leading creative firms – and an understanding of what it takes to thrive in the industries that shape how we see the world. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Set in one of the most dynamic and creative capitals in the world, our Creative Industries summer programme in London gives students aged 15–18 the opportunity to explore the future of design, media and storytelling. London is where fashion meets tech, music meets advertising and ideas move fast. This course invites you to dive into creative practice across disciplines – from brand development and digital campaigns to visual storytelling and user experience. You’ll work on practical briefs, visit cutting-edge studios and agencies, learn from industry insiders and explore how innovation is shaping the creative landscape today. In a city teeming with galleries, studios and start-ups, your creativity will be challenged and expanded at every turn. Whether you want to pursue a future in marketing, design, film, or creative direction, this summer programme offers the inspiration, insight and hands-on experience to help you begin carving your own creative path.

curriculum_sections.title: Project-Based Learning Sessions
curriculum_sections.body: In these two-hour sessions, Expert Tutors from the industry guide participants through hands-on tasks that provide practical, real-world experience. Each session is designed to equip students with essential skills directly relevant to their chosen field, allowing them to apply theoretical knowledge to practical tasks and gain confidence in industry-related skills.

curriculum_sections.title: Career Skills Sessions
curriculum_sections.body: These sessions cover vital areas such as career exploration, job search strategies, evaluating potential employers, crafting future CVs and writing impactful cover letters. Each session aims to build a comprehensive skill set that supports participants on their professional journey.

curriculum_sections.title: Expert Workshops
curriculum_sections.body: Led by Expert Tutors, these workshops provide insights into various career paths and industry practices. Participants benefit from the experiences shared by professionals, gaining practical knowledge and understanding of the skills required in their fields of interest. These sessions are designed to bridge the gap between academic learning and professional application, equipping students with tools essential for future success.

curriculum_sections.title: 1:1 Coaching Sessions
curriculum_sections.body: Each week, participants receive one-on-one sessions with their dedicated Expert Industry Tutor. These tailored meetings are designed to provide individual feedback and career-focused support, ensuring that each student receives guidance suited to their career planning, industry interests and personal development goals.

curriculum_sections.title: Work on Personal Project
curriculum_sections.body: Throughout the programme, students engage in individual projects that allow them to apply acquired knowledge and skills to real-world scenarios and work on their future career plans. This hands-on approach fosters critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, culminating in a comprehensive project presentation to industry experts.

curriculum_sections.title: Industry Visits
curriculum_sections.body: Industry visits offer participants firsthand exposure to their field of interest. Through visits to leading local companies and on-site guest speaker sessions, students gain invaluable insights into the industry landscape and have the opportunity to network with professionals, helping them understand potential career paths.

title: Economics in London
raw_title: Economics Summer Programme in London: University-Level Exploration
subject: Economics
description_short: Explore key topics like supply and demand, international trade and fiscal policy in our London Economics programme, designed for curious, analytical thinkers aged 15–18.
description_full: Understand economic systems and policy in London, a city that shapes global finance. Ideal for those looking for a European summer school in financial mathematics, this academic insights summer course explores theory, markets and development through seminars, data-led projects and critical discussion. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Understand the foundations of financial systems and policy at the Economics Summer School in London, designed for students aged 15–18 with an interest in markets, governments and global development. Explore topics like supply and demand, trade, inflation and inequality through academic instruction, data analysis and engaging group projects. Build confidence in evaluating arguments, interpreting financial data and predicting economic trends. London’s position as a global financial hub allows you to connect classroom learning to real-world policy and investment decisions. This European summer school in financial mathematics is ideal for those preparing for university-level study in economics, business, politics, or international relations.

curriculum_sections.title: In-depth academic sessions
curriculum_sections.body: Immerse yourself in rigorous academic sessions, led by expert tutors from prestigious universities. These classes go beyond standard curricula, challenging participants to explore complex concepts, engage in critical analysis and develop a sophisticated understanding that will add weight to any university application.

curriculum_sections.title: Personal research project
curriculum_sections.body: You’ll have the opportunity to develop your academic identity through a self-directed research project tailored to the subject you’re passionate about. With guidance from your tutor, you’ll craft original research questions, apply university-level methods and create meaningful work that showcases your curiosity to university admissions teams.

curriculum_sections.title: 1-on-1 tutoring
curriculum_sections.body: Experience personalised academic guidance from tutors who adapt their teaching to your unique learning style and goals. These individual sessions provide the perfect setting to clarify complex ideas, explore advanced topics of interest and receive focused feedback that will help you grow academically.

curriculum_sections.title: Certificate of achievement
curriculum_sections.body: Earn a respected certificate that recognises your academic accomplishments and commitment to life-long curiosity. This valuable recognition celebrates your dedication and intellectual development, while providing compelling evidence of your readiness for advanced study in the competitive world of university applications.

subject: Law
description_short: Explore how legal systems function and evolve in the heart of London. Study human rights, criminal law and tackle modern legal dilemmas.
description_full: Explore legal reasoning and justice in London, home to the UK’s most iconic courts and legal institutions. Immerse Education’s Law Summer School, specifically designed for students aged 15-18, develops your understanding of legal theory, ethics and courtroom practice through interactive academic sessions. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Step into the world of legal theory and justice at the Law Summer School in London, designed for students aged 16-18 who are curious about how the legal system shapes society. Study criminal and civil law, ethical debates and landmark legal cases through academic seminars, workshops and mock courtroom experiences. You’ll develop skills in reasoning, critical thinking and advocacy, learning how to build persuasive arguments and evaluate legislation. Guided by academic mentors and set in a city with a deep legal legacy, this course is ideal preparation for students considering law, politics, or related disciplines at university or beyond. Gain insight, experience and inspiration from a legal capital like no other.

title: Mathematics in London
raw_title: Mathematics Summer Programme in London: University-Level Exploration
subject: Mathematics
description_short: In London, explore how maths shapes the world. Tackle real problems using calculus, logic and data to build sharper thinking and confidence.
description_full: Sharpen your logical and numerical thinking in London, a city known for academic excellence and innovative mathematical research. Immerse Education’s Mathematics Summer School for students aged 15–18 explores algebra, calculus and statistics through challenging, small-class instruction and collaborative problem-solving. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Sharpen your mathematical thinking at our Mathematics Summer School in London, designed for students aged 15-18 who are preparing for university study in STEM. Explore algebra, calculus, probability and number theory through rigorous academic teaching and challenging problem sets. Work alongside peers in group tasks, apply abstract reasoning to practical questions and deepen your understanding of mathematical logic. With support from expert tutors, you’ll strengthen your problem-solving strategies and develop clear analytical thinking. London’s academic and cultural vibrancy offers an ideal space for students to explore the real-world applications of mathematics in science, technology, finance and beyond.

curriculum_sections.body: Immerse yourself in rigorous academic sessions, led by expert tutors from prestigious universities. These classes go beyond standard curricula, challenging participants to explore complex concepts, engage in critical analysis and develop a sophisticated understanding that will add weight to any university application.

curriculum_sections.body: You’ll have the opportunity to develop your academic identity through a self-directed research project tailored to the subject you’re passionate about. With guidance from your tutor, you’ll craft original research questions, apply university-level methods and create meaningful work that showcases your curiosity to university admissions teams.

curriculum_sections.title: 1-on-1 tutoring
curriculum_sections.body: Experience personalised academic guidance from tutors who adapt their teaching to your unique learning style and goals. These individual sessions provide the perfect setting to clarify complex ideas, explore advanced topics of interest and receive focused feedback that will help you grow academically.

curriculum_sections.title: Certificate of achievement
curriculum_sections.body: Earn a respected certificate that recognises your academic accomplishments and commitment to life-long curiosity. This valuable recognition celebrates your dedication and intellectual development, while providing compelling evidence of your readiness for advanced study in the competitive world of university applications.

We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Step into the world of medicine this summer in London, a city known for its advancements in healthcare and medical research. Immerse Education offers an exciting London medical summer school for students aged 15–18 who are passionate about medicine and healthcare. You’ll learn about human anatomy, biomedical sciences and how healthcare systems work. raw_title: Psychology Summer Programme in London: University-Level Exploration
subject: Psychology
description_short: Study the brain, behaviour and decision-making in London. Explore topics like memory, development and social influence through university-style seminars and projects.
description_full: Explore the human mind and behaviour in London, a global hub of research and education. Immerse Education’s Psychology Summer School for students aged 15–18 introduces cognition, emotion and development through psychological theory, case studies and hands-on academic exploration in a small-group setting. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Explore the workings of the mind at the Psychology Summer School in London, tailored for students aged 16–18 curious about cognition, behaviour and mental health. Investigate memory, emotion, perception and development through seminar discussions, fascinating case studies and collaborative research projects. You’ll learn how to design and critique your own psychology experiments, analyse human behaviour and apply psychological theory to everyday contexts. With guidance from experienced tutors, this course builds your academic writing and critical thinking skills. Set in one of the world’s most diverse cities, it offers a rich backdrop to explore how psychological principles apply to society and culture.

title: Architecture in Oxford
subject: Architecture
description_short: Participants will explore Oxford with an architect’s eye, analysing each building, structure and feature and applying these insights to their own designs.
description_full: Explore the world of architecture in the historic city of Oxford, home to some of the most iconic and renowned buildings in the UK. Immerse Education’s Architecture programme offers participants aged 13-15 an opportunity to examine Oxford’s built environment, study architectural design principles, explore innovative building techniques and work on design projects. Explore the world of architecture in the historic city of Oxford, home to some of the most iconic and renowned buildings in the UK. Immerse Education’s Architecture programme offers participants aged 16-18 the chance to explore Oxford with an architect’s eye, analysing each building, structure and feature and applying these insights to their own designs. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Get an incredible chance to step into the world of architecture in Oxford, a city famed for its historic charm and academic excellence. Immerse Education’s Architecture Summer School in Oxford invites students aged 13–18 to explore a fascinating blend of design, innovation and history in a city where timeless structures and contemporary ideas blend into unique cityscapes. This summer school is carefully crafted to suit all levels of interest and ability. Younger students will uncover the fundamentals of spatial design and creativity, while older participants will dive into topics like sustainable architecture, urban planning and advanced design techniques. Whether you’re taking your first steps into architecture or preparing for advanced studies, this programme provides the perfect opportunity to immerse yourself in learning, surrounded by stunning Oxford University architecture and landmarks.

subject: Criminology
description_short: What causes crime? Who defines justice? In Oxford, explore real-world cases, debate big ideas and learn how criminology connects to everyday life.
description_full: Step into the world of crime and justice in Oxford, a city where centuries of legal thought meet modern academia. Immerse Education’s criminology summer programs for high school students examine criminal behaviour, the justice system and key social issues, encouraging thoughtful debate and analysis. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Study criminal behaviour, justice systems and social impact at the Criminology Summer School in Oxford, designed for students aged 16-18. Explore how society defines crime and how criminal justice systems operate across the world. Examine real-life case studies and learn to analyse criminal motives, social inequality and legal responses. Our criminology summer programs for high school students provide academic guidance from expert tutors, allowing them to explore complex criminological theory, forensic psychology and legal frameworks through debate and structured learning. Oxford’s museums, landmarks and libraries offer thought-provoking settings in which to develop your critical thinking and research skills – ideal preparation for further study in law, sociology, or politics.

subject: English Literature
description_short: Explore classic and modern literature in Oxford. Sharpen your writing, learn literary theory and build confidence through workshops, discussions and expert feedback.
description_full: Dive into literature in Oxford, surrounded by the legacy of famous writers and scholars. Immerse Education’s Oxford University-based english literature summer school for students aged 16–18 explores classic and contemporary texts, literary theory and critical analysis in a truly inspiring academic setting. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Delve into the literary tradition at our Oxford University-based English Literature summer school, crafted for students aged 16-18 with a passion for reading and analysis. Study poetry, prose and drama from across literary periods, exploring the themes, contexts and techniques that have shaped great works. Learn how to develop your own critical voice through essay writing, discussion and text-based workshops. From Chaucer to contemporary fiction, you’ll encounter a wide range of literature and sharpen your analytical and interpretative skills. As with our English Literature summer school in Cambridge, you’ll journey through the literary cannon in the streets that inspired some of histories most influential authors, essays, poets and critics.

description_full: Explore engineering in Toronto, a city known for innovation and sustainability. Immerse Education’s Engineering Summer School for students aged 15–18 builds practical and theoretical understanding through collaborative design tasks and academic instruction across disciplines like civil, mechanical and electrical engineering. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Learn how engineers solve global challenges at the Engineering Summer School in Toronto, created for students aged 15-18 preparing for STEM degrees. Study civil, electrical and mechanical engineering through a combination of academic lessons, group challenges and project-based learning. Learn how to apply design thinking, sustainability principles and scientific theory to real-world problems. With support from experienced tutors, you’ll develop the teamwork, communication and analytical skills needed for future academic success. Toronto’s innovation and infrastructure ecosystem make it an exciting place to study Engineering in Canada. This course gives students the technical knowledge and creative problem-solving tools to take their engineering ambitions further.

Immerse Education’s Law Summer School for high school students aged 15–18 explores legal reasoning, rights and courtroom processes through small-group seminars, simulated legal debate and mock trials. We provide life-changing experiences that challenge, inspire and prepare ambitious students around the world. We empower participants with the knowledge, skills and confidence to thrive in their chosen paths. Examine justice and society at the Law Summer School in Toronto, created for students aged 16-18 who are considering careers in law, policy, or social advocacy. Study legal systems, constitutional principles and human rights through academic lectures, case analysis and mock courtroom sessions. Learn how to form persuasive arguments, interpret legislation and explore the role of law in shaping society. With expert guidance, you’ll develop confidence in public speaking, critical thinking and written expression. Toronto’s diverse legal landscape provides the perfect setting to study Law in Canada as an international student. This course offers a rigorous foundation in legal studies that prepares students for university and beyond.

description_short: Develop a university-level research paper online with guidance from an expert academic. Students aged 13-18 can choose from 20 subjects, flexible year-round start dates and 10- or 15-contact-hour pathways, including accredited options.
description_full: Immerse Education's Online Research Programme gives students aged 13-18 the opportunity to complete an advanced, undergraduate-style research project from anywhere in the world. Each participant selects a subject and area of specialisation, develops a research question and produces a full-length academic paper with guidance from a tutor whose expertise was developed at Oxford, Cambridge or an Ivy League institution. The programme combines scheduled online contact with independent research and writing. Classic study comprises 10 contact hours; accredited and advanced pathways generally comprise 15 contact hours, while the Publication Research Pathway adds four coaching sessions and continued publication support. Start dates are bespoke and online sessions run throughout the year, allowing study to be arranged around school and other commitments. Pathways include Classic, UK Accredited, USA Accredited, Group Accredited and Publication Research. Depending on the selected pathway and the student's age, outcomes may include independent assessment, detailed tutor feedback, a certificate of completion, eligibility for 8 UCAS points, US college credit, an invitation to the Immerse Online Symposium or support targeting an international high-school research journal.

curriculum_sections.title: Personalised academic research project
curriculum_sections.body: Students choose a subject, define an area of specialisation and complete an advanced research project that culminates in a full-length academic paper. The topic and level are tailored to the participant's interests, prior knowledge and academic goals.

curriculum_sections.title: Expert online tuition
curriculum_sections.body: Participants learn online with subject specialists who have academic experience connected to Oxford, Cambridge or Ivy League institutions. Most pathways use regular one-to-one tutorials; a group-accredited route is also listed for students who prefer peer learning.

curriculum_sections.title: University-level research skills
curriculum_sections.body: The programme introduces the methods expected in undergraduate study: finding and using academic journals, referencing sources correctly, evaluating the quality of evidence, comparing conflicting sources, developing a sustained argument and communicating findings in formal academic writing.

curriculum_sections.title: Independent study and feedback
curriculum_sections.body: Contact hours are combined with research and project preparation completed in the student's own time. Tutors provide personalised feedback throughout the process, identify academic strengths and recommend practical next steps for developing subject knowledge and research skills.

curriculum_sections.title: Assessment and recognition
curriculum_sections.body: The finished research project is independently assessed and participants receive a certificate of completion. Students aged 14 or over who select the UK Accredited pathway can work toward a National Open College Network qualification worth 8 UCAS points. The USA Accredited pathway offers US college credit through Immerse's partner organisation.

curriculum_sections.title: Publication and presentation opportunities
curriculum_sections.body: Participants may be invited to present their work at the Immerse Online Symposium and can explore opportunities to publish through Immerse. The dedicated Publication Research Pathway includes four coaching sessions, ongoing support and guidance aimed at preparing work for an international high-school research journal.

curriculum_sections.title: Subjects available
curriculum_sections.body: Subject choices listed on the programme page include Architecture, Artificial Intelligence, Biology, Business Management, Chemistry, Coding, Computer Science, Creative Writing, Economics, Encryption and Cybersecurity, Engineering, English Literature, History, International Relations, Law, Mathematics, Medicine, Philosophy, Physics and Psychology.

curriculum_sections.title: Flexible year-round structure
curriculum_sections.body: The programme is delivered fully online and is built around individual, self-paced or one-to-one study rather than a residential cohort. Bespoke start dates and sessions throughout the year allow the timetable to be arranged around the participant. A computer or tablet, internet access and a working webcam are required.

Locate, reference and critically evaluate scholarly sources
Compare evidence and assess conflicting interpretations
Plan and write a sustained university-level research paper
Work independently while responding constructively to expert feedback
Develop deeper knowledge in a chosen academic subject
Present and discuss research findings with greater confidence

detail_intro: Immerse Education's Online Research Programme is a flexible, year-round virtual programme for students aged 13-18. Participants complete a university-level research paper in a chosen subject through 10 or 15 hours of expert contact, supported by independent study and personalised feedback.

detail_sections.title: Overview
detail_sections.body: The Online Research Programme allows motivated students aged 13-18 to undertake an advanced academic project from anywhere in the world. Instead of following fixed summer dates or a residential timetable, each participant works toward a full-length research paper through flexible online sessions and independent study. The programme is designed to deepen subject knowledge, build the research and writing skills expected at university and give students first-hand experience of tutorial-style learning.

detail_sections.title: What students explore
detail_sections.body: Students select one of 20 listed subjects and agree on an area of specialisation with their tutor. They learn how to develop a research question, navigate academic journals, reference authors correctly, distinguish strong evidence from weak evidence, assess conflicting sources and build a coherent scholarly argument. The project culminates in a full-length academic paper assessed at university level. Available fields include Architecture, Artificial Intelligence, Biology, Business Management, Chemistry, Coding, Computer Science, Creative Writing, Economics, Encryption and Cybersecurity, Engineering, English Literature, History, International Relations, Law, Mathematics, Medicine, Philosophy, Physics and Psychology.

detail_sections.title: Teaching and project support
detail_sections.body: The programme combines live online contact with substantial independent preparation. Participants are matched with an expert according to their academic background and chosen field. Tutors have experience linked to universities such as Oxford, Cambridge or Ivy League institutions and adapt the tutorials to the student's interests and goals. Along the way, students receive focused feedback, an evaluation of their final submission and recommendations for further academic development. One-to-one tuition is central to the Classic and accredited routes, while a group-accredited option is also listed.

detail_sections.title: How the programme works
detail_sections.body: After applying and paying the required deposit, the student supplies additional information about their background and interests. Immerse then matches the participant with an appropriate specialist tutor. The student begins a 10- or 15-contact-hour course, completing research and writing between tutorials in their own time. At the end, the academic paper is independently assessed and the participant receives a certificate of completion. A computer or tablet, reliable internet access and a working webcam are required.

detail_sections.title: Pathways and recognition
detail_sections.body: The Classic pathway provides 10 hours of personalised research guidance and is open to ages 13-18. The UK Accredited pathway provides 15 hours for ages 14-18 and is accredited by the National Open College Network; successful completion can provide a qualification worth 8 UCAS points. The USA Accredited pathway provides 15 hours for ages 14-18 and offers US college credit through a partner organisation. A Group Accredited pathway is also listed for collaborative online study. The Publication Research Pathway combines 15 contact hours with four coaching sessions, runs over approximately four weeks with ongoing support and is intended for students seeking publication in an independent international high-school research journal. Accreditation and credit eligibility depend on the selected pathway and participant age.

detail_sections.title: Schedule, ages and format
detail_sections.body: Format: fully online, with one-to-one or group study depending on the chosen pathway. Age range: 13-18; accredited pathways that award UCAS points are intended for participants aged 14-18. Teaching is measured in contact hours rather than weeks: the main options provide 10 or 15 contact hours, with additional independent research and writing completed outside tutorials. The Publication Research Pathway also includes four coaching sessions and ongoing support. There are no fixed seasonal dates in the listing; bespoke start dates and online sessions are available throughout the year.

detail_sections.title: Fees
detail_sections.body: The saved provider page lists the Group Accredited Online Research Programme at £745, the 10-hour Classic pathway at £2,695, the 15-hour UK Accredited pathway at £3,995, the 15-hour USA Accredited pathway at £3,995 and the Publication Research Pathway at £4,995. The publication route includes 15 contact hours plus four coaching sessions. Families should confirm current availability, inclusions, deposits and credit requirements directly with Immerse Education before booking.

detail_sections.title: Location
detail_sections.body: This is a fully virtual programme that can be joined from anywhere in the world. Sessions are arranged online around the participant's agreed timetable.

detail_sections_tr.title: Öğrenciler Neleri Keşfeder
detail_sections_tr.body: Öğrenciler listelenen 20 alandan birini seçer ve eğitmenleriyle birlikte bir uzmanlaşma konusu belirler. Araştırma sorusu geliştirme, akademik dergileri kullanma, kaynakları doğru biçimde gösterme, güçlü ve zayıf kanıtları ayırt etme, çelişen kaynakları değerlendirme ve tutarlı bir akademik argüman kurma üzerinde çalışırlar. Proje, üniversite düzeyinde değerlendirilen tam uzunlukta bir akademik makaleyle tamamlanır. Alanlar arasında Mimarlık, Yapay Zeka, Biyoloji, İşletme Yönetimi, Kimya, Kodlama, Bilgisayar Bilimi, Yaratıcı Yazarlık, Ekonomi, Şifreleme ve Siber Güvenlik, Mühendislik, İngiliz Edebiyatı, Tarih, Uluslararası İlişkiler, Hukuk, Matematik, Tıp, Felsefe, Fizik ve Psikoloji bulunur.

detail_sections_tr.title: Eğitim ve Proje Desteği
detail_sections_tr.body: Program, canlı çevrimiçi görüşmeleri kapsamlı bağımsız hazırlıkla birleştirir. Katılımcılar akademik geçmişlerine ve seçtikleri alana göre uygun bir uzmanla eşleştirilir. Eğitmenler Oxford, Cambridge veya Ivy League üniversiteleriyle bağlantılı akademik deneyime sahiptir ve görüşmeleri öğrencinin ilgi alanları ile hedeflerine göre uyarlar. Öğrenciler süreç boyunca odaklı geri bildirim, nihai çalışmalarına ilişkin ayrıntılı değerlendirme ve sonraki akademik gelişimleri için öneriler alır. Classic ve akredite yollarda birebir eğitim temel yapıdayken grup akrediteli bir seçenek de listelenmektedir.

detail_sections_tr.title: Program Nasıl İşler
detail_sections_tr.body: Başvuru ve gerekli depozito ödemesinden sonra öğrenci akademik geçmişi ve ilgi alanları hakkında ek bilgi sunar. Immerse, katılımcıyı uygun bir uzman eğitmenle eşleştirir. Öğrenci 10 veya 15 saatlik programına başlar; görüşmeler arasındaki araştırma ve yazma çalışmalarını kendi zamanında tamamlar. Sürecin sonunda akademik makale bağımsız olarak değerlendirilir ve katılımcıya tamamlama sertifikası verilir. Bilgisayar veya tablet, güvenilir internet bağlantısı ve çalışan bir web kamerası gereklidir.

detail_sections_tr.title: Program Yolları ve Kazanımlar
detail_sections_tr.body: Classic yolu, 13-18 yaş için 10 saat kişiselleştirilmiş araştırma rehberliği sunar. UK Accredited yolu, 14-18 yaş için 15 saat eğitim verir ve National Open College Network tarafından akredite edilmiştir; başarıyla tamamlama 8 UCAS puanı değerinde bir yeterlilik sağlayabilir. USA Accredited yolu, 14-18 yaş için 15 saat eğitim sunar ve ortak kuruluş aracılığıyla ABD üniversite kredisi sağlar. İş birlikli çevrimiçi çalışma için Group Accredited seçeneği de listelenmiştir. Publication Research Pathway ise 15 görüşme saatini dört koçluk oturumuyla birleştirir, devam eden destekle yaklaşık dört hafta sürer ve bağımsız bir uluslararası lise araştırma dergisinde yayın hedefleyen öğrencilere yöneliktir. Akreditasyon ve kredi uygunluğu seçilen yola ve katılımcının yaşına bağlıdır.

detail_sections_tr.title: Takvim, Yaş Aralığı ve Format
detail_sections_tr.body: Format: seçilen yola göre birebir veya grup çalışmasıyla tamamen çevrimiçi. Yaş aralığı: 13-18; UCAS puanı sağlayan akredite yollar 14-18 yaş katılımcılar içindir. Eğitim hafta yerine görüşme saatiyle ölçülür: ana seçenekler 10 veya 15 saatlik uzman görüşmesi içerir; bağımsız araştırma ve yazma çalışmaları bu saatlerin dışında tamamlanır. Publication Research Pathway ayrıca dört koçluk oturumu ve devam eden destek içerir. İlanda sabit mevsimsel tarihler bulunmaz; kişiye özel başlangıç tarihleri ve çevrimiçi oturumlar yıl boyunca sunulur.

detail_sections_tr.title: Ücretler
detail_sections_tr.body: Kaydedilen sağlayıcı sayfasında Group Accredited Online Research Programme £745, 10 saatlik Classic yolu £2.695, 15 saatlik UK Accredited yolu £3.995, 15 saatlik USA Accredited yolu £3.995 ve Publication Research Pathway £4.995 olarak listelenmiştir. Yayın odaklı yol 15 görüşme saatine ek olarak dört koçluk oturumu içerir. Ailelerin rezervasyon öncesinde güncel kontenjanı, kapsama dahil hizmetleri, depozito koşullarını ve kredi gerekliliklerini doğrudan Immerse Education ile doğrulaması önerilir.

detail_sections_tr.title: Konum
detail_sections_tr.body: Bu, dünyanın her yerinden katılmaya uygun tamamen sanal bir programdır. Oturumlar, katılımcıyla kararlaştırılan takvime göre çevrimiçi düzenlenir.

subject: AI & Software
description_short: Are you interested in AI & Software Engineering? Join our computer science summer school in London, designed for students aged 15-18. description_full: Are you interested in AI & Software Engineering? Join our computer science summer school in London, designed for students aged 15-18. Over the course of two weeks, students will get to step into the shoes of a computer scientist working in London, through a range of immersive career simulations and exclusive professional site visits. Programme robots, design your own video game and become a pro using Figma – the industry standard app design tool. Plus, gain a qualification in work experience to boost your university application! Register now for a life-changing experience that will set you up for a future as a successful computer scientist, or contact us to find out more.

curriculum_sections.title: Overview
curriculum_sections.body: Overview Are you interested in AI & Software Engineering? Join our computer science summer school in London, designed for students aged 15-18. Over the course of two weeks, students will get to step into the shoes of a computer scientist working in London, through a range of immersive career simulations and exclusive professional site visits. Programme robots, design your own video game and become a pro using Figma – the industry standard app design tool. Plus, gain a qualification in work experience to boost your university application! Register now for a life-changing experience that will set you up for a future as a successful computer scientist, or contact us to find out more. Read all highights

curriculum_sections.title: The World of AI & Software
curriculum_sections.body: The World of AI & Software Understand key career paths: software engineering, video game designing and the emerging worlds of AI and machine learning Take part in icebreaker activities to get to know your fellow students Learn about the blend between innovation and computer science and see how tech entrepreneurs are changing the world Career coaching on skills needed to become an outstanding computer scientist

curriculum_sections.title: Robotics
curriculum_sections.body: Robotics Understand the complex ethics surrounding robotics and AI Assemble an educational obstacle avoidance robot in teams Programme your robot in teams in a line following workshop using it’s built in sensors Use scratch based coding or python to help your robot navigate around depending on your skill level

curriculum_sections.title: UI/UX & Front End-Engineering
curriculum_sections.body: UI/UX & Front End-Engineering Become the UX designer: learn how to gather a client’s requirements, Using Figma: Undertake a masterclass in the programme Figma, the programmers toolkit to app development Explore the ‘front-end’ (also known as client side) of software engineering Discover the most important software-building tools: HTML, CSS, JavaScript and more Web development simulation, create a full-stack project using Python & Java

curriculum_sections.title: Back End Engineering
curriculum_sections.body: Back End Engineering Explore the main algorithms and discover how to solve programming problems efficiently Get hands-on: create the back end of a full-stack project using Python Learn common methodologies, tips and tricks to perform better when coding Showcase your work from the summer experience so far and receive feedback from professionals Discover cybersecurity: an essential service for the security of nation states and businesses

curriculum_sections.title: The Ethics of AI
curriculum_sections.body: The Ethics of AI Look ahead to the future of AI and discover the potential benefits and challenges Understand the role of ethics and regulation in the AI industry Put your knowledge and imagination to the test in a debate against your peers

curriculum_sections.title: The Game Jam
curriculum_sections.body: The Game Jam Explore the foundational elements of what makes a great video game, Story, game design, level creation UI/UX Design Develop your concept and put your ideas into action Discover the tools used by professionals to craft unique gameplay features Continue working on your game throughout the day Conclude the game jam with an ‘alpha testing session’ alongside your fellow students & awards ceremony

curriculum_sections.title: The Fintech Forum
curriculum_sections.body: The Fintech Forum Learn about the world of financial technology and its impact on the UK techspace Using your UI/UX skills, in teams, devise a trading app with a unique selling point Work with entrepreneurs and financiers to build an app Demonstrate a plan for your app Receive feedback on your design and ideas from software engineers, bankers and entrepreneurs Network with other ambitious students

curriculum_sections.title: Graduation & Certification
curriculum_sections.body: Graduation & Certification Celebrate everything you’ve achieved over the course of the programme and receive your industry reference letter signed by professionals outlining your accomplishments.

curriculum_sections.title: Immersive Experiences 2 Week Enhanced
curriculum_sections.body: Immersive Experiences 2 Week Enhanced Upgrade your 2-Week Summer Experience to Enhanced and gain an extra 15 hours of exclusive time with professionals and build a professional development portfolio to kickstart your future career. The 2-Week Enhanced option includes all the benefits and experiences of the first and second weeks, plus a weekend of extra career development opportunities and a private Gala dinner on the penultimate evening. The assessment to receive a Level 3 Award in Work Experience and UCAS points is also included.

curriculum_sections.title: Highlights
curriculum_sections.body: Highlights Participate in a series of expert professional development and university admissions masterclasses such as CV-writing, LinkedIn & personal branding, Oxbridge & Ivy League applications Undertake expert psychometric testing & personality profiling to develop your self-awareness and understand your core strengths, motivations and development areas Compete as a team in an assessed immersive strategy game Attend a private Gala dinner in central London with professionals, with keynote speeches and a networking reception Have your work assessed to receive a Level 3 Award in Work Experience and UCAS points to add to your university application.

description_full: Are you an aspiring architect? Join our architecture summer school in London, designed for students aged 15-18. Over the course of two weeks, students will get to step into the shoes of an architect working in London, through a range of immersive career simulations and exclusive professional site visits. Visit leading architecture firms, design your own sustainable structure and pitch your ideas to a panel of architects in an iconic London venue. Plus, gain a qualification to boost your university application! Register now for a life-changing experience that will set you up for a future as a successful architect, or contact us to find out more.

curriculum_sections.title: The Architecture Studio
curriculum_sections.body: The Architecture Studio Discover the architectural design process: research, collage, concept design, developed design and presentation board Learn the difference between plan, section and axonometric drawings and their purpose within the design process in an interactive workshop with a leading architect Engage in a 3D physical-modelling workshop: learn how to transform simple materials into magnificent miniatures of your architectural space

curriculum_sections.title: Become the Architect
curriculum_sections.body: Become the Architect Receive your first design brief and work with your team to analyse the client’s needs Visit an inner-city site and document your findings through note-taking and conceptual sketching Pool together your research, sketches and collage to align on the concept that will underpin your project Build physical structures to best visualise your designs Engage in a ‘cross-crit’: exchange feedback, benchmark your ideas and refine your designs

curriculum_sections.title: Firm Visit
curriculum_sections.body: Firm Visit Visit an architecture firm and understand the day-to-day life of an architect Get hands-on experience of how a firm operates, learning how they approach their own design briefs Participate in a live panel Q&A session and gain invaluable advice Network with top architecture professionals

curriculum_sections.title: Pitch to the Client
curriculum_sections.body: Pitch to the Client Bring all your work together: curate your project narrative on presentation boards at a landmark London building Perfect your elevator pitching skills: concisely describe your project to the client and communicate your design choices effectively Have your project assessed according to industry standard crit guidelines Receive detailed feedback on your work from leading experts in the field

curriculum_sections.title: Designing a Sustainable Structure
curriculum_sections.body: Designing a Sustainable Structure Meet experts in urban planning and discover how sustainable architectural firms are addressing climate issues in urban areas Receive your second brief: work in teams to construct an environmentally-friendly urban space Investigate the way communities interact with their environment Research the materials and systems that will be used in your sustainable structure before implementing them into your final designs Learn 3D modelling skills that are becoming essential for modern architectural practice and digital workflows Pitch your finished project to leading urban planning professionals

curriculum_sections.title: Site Research and Development
curriculum_sections.body: Site Research and Development Take a tour of one of London’s regenerated areas and use your newfound knowledge to redevelop the area Learn about the history of your site and use this knowledge in your design development Pitch your design proposals to experts and receive feedback

curriculum_sections.title: The Exhibition
curriculum_sections.body: The Exhibition Organise a ‘showroom’ to exhibit your design projects from the Summer Experience Learn curation techniques that will enhance your exhibit Write a statement to underpin your exhibition Network with leading architects and get invaluable feedback on your work and a chance to get one on one feedback on your portfolio

description_full: Are you an aspiring artist? Join our art summer school in London, designed for students aged 15-18. Over the course of 2 weeks, students will get to step into the shoes of an artist and designer working in London, through a range of immersive career simulations and exclusive professional site visits. You’ll explore an iconic London gallery with experts, build your portfolio with a range of artistic masterclasses and exhibit your work at a real London gallery space. Plus, gain a qualification in work experience to boost your university application! Register now for a life-changing experience that will set you up for a future as a successful artist.

Over the course of 2 weeks, students will get to step into the shoes of an artist and designer working in London, through a range of immersive career simulations and exclusive professional site visits. You’ll explore an iconic London gallery with experts, build your portfolio with a range of artistic masterclasses and exhibit your work at a real London gallery space.
