curriculum_sections.title: Explore an iconic London gallery with experts
curriculum_sections.body: Explore an iconic London gallery with experts Visit one of London’s top public galleries and delve into art history with an in-depth tour Study the different techniques used by the world’s most influential artists Sketch the London skyline, with guidance from an experienced artist Discover curation and learn what goes on behind the scenes at an exhibition Develop your critical eye by learning how to evaluate and interpret works on display

curriculum_sections.title: Enter the Artist’s Studio
curriculum_sections.body: Enter the Artist’s Studio Try your hand at different mediums with a series of artistic masterclasses: Learn to sculpt your own 3D self-portrait in a guided clay workshop Experiment with different materials and techniques in an intensive life-drawing class Explore the world of print and design by creating your own screen print Create your own sketchbook and learn DIY bookbinding Receive feedback on your work from professional artists and critique the work of your peers

curriculum_sections.title: Illustration and Animation
curriculum_sections.body: Illustration and Animation Learn what it takes to be an illustrator: commercial clients, freelancing, procuring commissions and more Develop your own unique style in a character design workshop led by an experienced illustrator Learn the range of techniques deployed by top animators Discover the animation process: from concept to film Design a character and draw up a storyboard for your very own animation Film your stop motion claymation using your own character designs

curriculum_sections.title: The Portfolio
curriculum_sections.body: The Portfolio Learn what top art and design schools look for in a portfolio Try your hand at photography in a professional studio as you photograph your previous work for your portfolio Create a physical portfolio cover using traditional water marbling techniques Compile your work from across the summer experience into a portfolio to use in university applications, grant and awards applications

curriculum_sections.title: Filmmaking
curriculum_sections.body: Filmmaking Play the role of a prop designer and art director on a film set Recreate an iconic film scene Screen your film recreation to directors and artists and receive feedback

curriculum_sections.title: Concept Art
curriculum_sections.body: Concept Art Learn what concept art is and how it shaped characters, environments and stories in games, films and animation. Design the visuals for your own game and get feedback from industry professionals. Gain insight into both traditional and digital tools

curriculum_sections.title: Textiles
curriculum_sections.body: Textiles Explore a variety of textile skills, from sewing and stitching to patternmaking Experiment with different materials to bring your ideas to life Get guidance and tips to improve your work

curriculum_sections.title: Graphic Design, Branding and Marketing
curriculum_sections.body: Graphic Design, Branding and Marketing Art vs design: what’s the difference? Learn the basic principles of design Understand the importance of branding, in marketing and beyond Design the poster and invitations for your own art exhibition Work together to plan, budget and execute your very own exhibition with a team of graphic designers and curators providing insights on your work

curriculum_sections.title: The Exhibition
curriculum_sections.body: The Exhibition Arrive at an exclusive London gallery space to curate your very own exhibition Hang your work: consider how light, proportion and placement impact the viewer’s experience of each piece Label your artwork, apply the final touches to your display and prepare the gallery ahead of your first visitors Invite top artists, designers, agents, curators and art directors to a private viewing Escort the experts around your exhibition and get invaluable feedback on your work

curriculum_sections.title: Graduation & Certification
curriculum_sections.body: Graduation & Certification Celebrate everything you’ve achieved over the course of the programme and receive your industry reference letter signed by professionals outlining your accomplishments.

curriculum_sections.title: Immersive Experiences 2 Week Enhanced
curriculum_sections.body: Immersive Experiences 2 Week Enhanced Upgrade your 2-Week Summer Experience to Enhanced and gain an extra 15 hours of exclusive time with professionals and build a professional development portfolio to kickstart your future career. The 2-Week Enhanced option includes all the benefits and experiences of the first and second weeks, plus a weekend of extra career development opportunities and a private Gala dinner on the penultimate evening. The assessment to receive a Level 3 Award in Work Experience and UCAS points is also included.

curriculum_sections.title: Highlights
curriculum_sections.body: Highlights Participate in a series of expert professional development and university admissions masterclasses such as CV-writing, LinkedIn & personal branding, Oxbridge & Ivy League applications Undertake expert psychometric testing & personality profiling to develop your self-awareness and understand your core strengths, motivations and development areas Compete as a team in an assessed immersive strategy game Attend a private Gala dinner in central London with professionals, with keynote speeches and a networking reception Have your work assessed to receive a Level 3 Award in Work Experience and UCAS points to add to your university application.

curriculum_sections.body: Venues: The programme is based at UCL and the surrounding University of London campus. Certain days take place in other key industry locations in London.

curriculum_sections.body: Accommodation location: Students live on university campus in central London and are allocated to halls of residence used by University of London students, including those from UCL and LSE. description_full: Are you an aspiring engineer? Join our engineering summer school in London, designed for students aged 15-18. Over the course of 2 weeks, students will get to step into the shoes of an engineer working in London, through a range of immersive career simulations and exclusive professional site visits. Take apart a petrol engine, visit the largest collection of classic cars in the UK and board a Boeing jet with aerospace engineers. Plus, gain a qualification in work experience to boost university applications! Register now for a life-changing experience that will set you up for a future as a successful engineer, or contact us to find out more.

curriculum_sections.body: Overview Are you an aspiring engineer? Join our engineering summer school in London, designed for students aged 15-18. Over the course of 2 weeks, students will get to step into the shoes of an engineer working in London, through a range of immersive career simulations and exclusive professional site visits. Take apart a petrol engine, visit the largest collection of classic cars in the UK and board a Boeing jet with aerospace engineers. Plus, gain a qualification in work experience to boost university applications! Register now for a life-changing experience that will set you up for a future as a successful engineer, or contact us to find out more. Read all highights

curriculum_sections.title: Civil and Structural Engineering
curriculum_sections.body: Civil and Structural Engineering Use core concepts and real-world constraints to design a civil engineering masterpiece Build a structure to carry weight across two points in a graduate recruitment-style group task Compete against other attendees to impress the judges and become the most successful engineer

curriculum_sections.title: Aeronautical and Aerospace
curriculum_sections.body: Aeronautical and Aerospace Understand the physics of flight when manufacturing a high-performing aerofoil Work with a Rolls Royce engineer to improve and test 3D-printed aerofoil designs Find the optimum conditions for flight using a wind tunnel Discuss your results with top material and aerospace engineers and propose solutions to achieve the most aerodynamic design Get a taste of university-level applied physics and maths to deepen your understanding of engineering and how these subjects power real-world innovations Take part in a mission to mars activity led by an leading systems engineer to design your transportation architecture

curriculum_sections.title: The Boeing Experience
curriculum_sections.body: The Boeing Experience Visit an airfield and explore a range of commercial aircraft with pilots and aerospace engineers Learn how the design of different aircraft and gliders varies depending on function Rig and derig a glass fibre glider with traditional controls, working as a team to lift the wings and secure the main rigging pins Work alongside electrical engineers and pilots to programme a fly-by-wire control panel

curriculum_sections.title: Materials Engineering
curriculum_sections.body: Materials Engineering Explore the Field of Materials Engineering: Gain an insightful introduction to the vital role of materials engineers in shaping the future of technology and innovation Graphene Isolation and manipulation: Participate in the isolation of graphene, a ground breaking material and apply it to create functional electrical circuits Metallurgic Failure Analysis: Learn the principles behind metallurgic failure analysis and understand its importance in assessing material integrity and performance Act as a Professional Engineer: Take on the role of a materials engineer by conducting your own failure analysis, enhancing your problem-solving and analytical capabilities Produce your own professional metallurgic failure report and receive expert feedback from an industry professional on the quality and accuracy of your analysis

curriculum_sections.title: How to Become a Successful Engineer
curriculum_sections.body: How to Become a Successful Engineer Your path to success: understanding the key decisions ahead and how to maximise your chances of success Making the right subject choices: A-level/IB/university and beyond Securing work experience and designing an impactful CV/resume Powerful interview techniques Coaching from engineers on what you can do now to stand out in the future

curriculum_sections.title: Enter the Supercar Studio
curriculum_sections.body: Enter the Supercar Studio Gain access to the largest collection of classic cars in the UK and discover the evolution of the motor vehicle Meet engineers who have helped create the world's most prestigious cars Learn the unique engineering features of one of the most sought-after cars in the world Take apart a petrol engine under the supervision of a top mechanical engineer Assess the transformation of vehicles as we move away from petrol towards electric energy

curriculum_sections.title: Engineering and the Environment
curriculum_sections.body: Engineering and the Environment Explore the intricacies of the environmentally friendly design and uncover its dual purpose Use what you’ve learnt in a simulated climate emergency: Test your engineering problem solving skills and work together to research and design your own innovative solution to a current climate emergency engineers are working to solve Present your group proposal to a leading sustainability professional Receive live feedback on your solutions

curriculum_sections.title: Biomedical Engineering
curriculum_sections.body: Biomedical Engineering Introduction to Biomedical Engineering: Discover how biomedical engineers are leading innovators, revolutionising scientific progress and improving individual patient care through personalised designs Hands-on Patient Analysis: Conduct your own patient analysis and develop innovative solutions to adapt current biomedical technologies, driving the next wave of scientific breakthroughs Guided by a Leading Expert: Work alongside a leading biomedical scientist who will mentor you through the process of innovation and patient centered technology design Experience Cutting-Edge Biomedical Technologies: Explore motion capture technology that visualizes your own skeleton and musculoskeletal interactions, giving you a deep understanding of prosthetic design

curriculum_sections.title: Electrical Engineering
curriculum_sections.body: Electrical Engineering Introduction to Electrical Engineering: Explore how electrical engineers are the backbone of technological innovation, driving advancements that power the world. Build & Code Your Own Robot: Design and program an obstacle-avoiding, line-following robot buggy using Arduino circuits, guided by an expert electrical engineer. Master Hardware-Software Integration: Gain key insights into how electrical engineers bridge the gap between software and hardware, a crucial skill for modern engineering. Decode Electrical Schematics: Learn how to interpret and work with electrical schematics, building a foundation for future engineering success.

curriculum_sections.title: Networking Event With Top Engineers
curriculum_sections.body: Networking Event With Top Engineers Take part in a private networking session with top engineers Put your newfound knowledge to the test Have your burning questions answered by those in the know Receive valuable advice from experts in the field

curriculum_sections.title: Graduation & Certification
curriculum_sections.body: Graduation & Certification Celebrate everything you’ve achieved over the course of the programme and receive your industry reference letter signed by professionals outlining your accomplishments.

curriculum_sections.title: Immersive Experiences 2 Week Enhanced
curriculum_sections.body: Immersive Experiences 2 Week Enhanced Upgrade your 2-Week Summer Experience to Enhanced and gain an extra 15 hours of exclusive time with professionals and build a professional development portfolio to kickstart your future career. The 2-Week Enhanced option includes all the benefits and experiences of the first and second weeks, plus a weekend of extra career development opportunities and a private Gala dinner on the penultimate evening. The assessment to receive a Level 3 Award in Work Experience and UCAS points is also included.

curriculum_sections.title: Highlights
curriculum_sections.body: Highlights Participate in a series of expert professional development and university admissions masterclasses such as CV-writing, LinkedIn & personal branding, Oxbridge & Ivy League applications Undertake expert psychometric testing & personality profiling to develop your self-awareness and understand your core strengths, motivations and development areas Compete as a team in an assessed immersive strategy game Attend a private Gala dinner in central London with professionals, with keynote speeches and a networking reception Have your work assessed to receive a Level 3 Award in Work Experience and UCAS points to add to your university application.

title: Forensic Scientist Summer Experience
subject: Forensic Science
description_short: Are you an aspiring forensic scientist? Join our forensics summer school in London, designed for students aged 15-18. Over the course of two weeks, students will get to step into the shoes of a forensic scientist working in London, through a range of immersive career simulations and exclusive professional site visits. Capture evidence at a simulated cri
description_full: Are you an aspiring forensic scientist? Join our forensics summer school in London, designed for students aged 15-18. Over the course of two weeks, students will get to step into the shoes of a forensic scientist working in London, through a range of immersive career simulations and exclusive professional site visits. Capture evidence at a simulated crime scene, perform fingerprint and blood spatter analysis and extract DNA in a state-of-the-art laboratory. Plus, gain a qualification in work experience to boost university applications! Register now for a life-changing experience that will set you up for a future as a successful forensic scientist or contact us to find out more.

curriculum_sections.title: Not sure which career to choose? Take our quiz to identify which career you are best suited to
curriculum_sections.body: Not sure which career to choose? Take our quiz to identify which career you are best suited to TAKE OUR CAREER QUIZ

curriculum_sections.title: Overview
curriculum_sections.body: Overview Are you an aspiring forensic scientist? Join our forensics summer school in London, designed for students aged 15-18. Over the course of two weeks, students will get to step into the shoes of a forensic scientist working in London, through a range of immersive career simulations and exclusive professional site visits. Capture evidence at a simulated crime scene, perform fingerprint and blood spatter analysis and extract DNA in a state-of-the-art laboratory. Plus, gain a qualification in work experience to boost university applications! Register now for a life-changing experience that will set you up for a future as a successful forensic scientist or contact us to find out more. Read all highights

curriculum_sections.title: The Forensic Mindset
curriculum_sections.body: The Forensic Mindset Discover what a day in the life of a forensic scientist entails Explore the demands and expectations of working in this exciting field Learn the difference between working in the field vs working in a laboratory Develop key soft skills: critical thinking, decision making and thinking ahead Learn important hard skills: basic analytical techniques, statistics and the use of UV light Master the basics of pipetting and risk assessments

curriculum_sections.title: Become the CSI
curriculum_sections.body: Become the CSI Examine the strategy used when approaching a crime scene Gain a thorough understanding of hygiene best practice and the clothing you’ll need Undertake a series of small escape room exercises with guidance from experienced forensic professionals Test your attention to detail and problem-solving skills Take on a series of real-life case studies exploring famous historical plots Race against the clock to unlock the truth and be the first to uncover the suspect

curriculum_sections.title: Enter the Crime Scene
curriculum_sections.body: Enter the Crime Scene Walk through a simulated crime scene: act as a first responder and a fingerprint analyst Sketch the scene with dimensions to keep on record Label and package the evidence into the correct containers to maintain integrity Learn the principles of fingerprint identification Perform finger-mark powdering and explore the effects different surfaces have on fingerprint deposition Explore the effects different surfaces have on fingerprint deposition Match the correct fingerprints to a potential suspect

curriculum_sections.title: Blood Spatter Analysis
curriculum_sections.body: Blood Spatter Analysis Familiarise yourself with the basics of blood pattern analysis: introduction, classification and terminology Observe how different blood patterns are generated in a crime Generate different spatter for subsequent analysis Identify the crime and then group the bloodstain patterns into different categories Reconstruct the scene: analyse the blood stain size, shape and distribution patterns in order to reconstruct the sequence of events that led to the bloodshed

curriculum_sections.title: Enter the Lab
curriculum_sections.body: Enter the Lab Get a first-hand account of what it’s like to work in a forensic laboratory: interact with the technicians and ask them all your burning questions Demonstrations on chromatography and other routine forensic procedures Perform DNA sample collection and extraction

curriculum_sections.title: Forensic Specialties
curriculum_sections.body: Forensic Specialties Start with a bang: explore the field of fire and explosives investigation Learn from forensic analysts as you examine evidence left behind after suspected arson Discover the process of explosives analysis and the technology used to identify bomb components Explore the field of forensic anthropology and its application in investigations Build a profile of a person based on their skeletal remains

curriculum_sections.title: The Courtroom
curriculum_sections.body: The Courtroom Step into the shoes of an expert witness in a simulated courtroom Compile evidence you have gathered throughout the programme to build your case Learn how to write and deliver expert testimony Take the stand as an expert and present your witness statement to your peers Undergo cross examination with live feedback from leading expert witnesses Gain valuable tips from forensic scientists who have testified on prominent cases

curriculum_sections.title: Cyber Forensics
curriculum_sections.body: Cyber Forensics Delve into digital forensics, the dark web and cyber attacks Examine how technology integrates itself into forensic investigations by examining the hidden side of the web Infiltrate a dark web marketplace and uncover the criminals behind it Discover the techniques used to bring down illegal transactions in the cyber-underworld

curriculum_sections.title: Networking Event With Top Forensic Scientists
curriculum_sections.body: Networking Event With Top Forensic Scientists Take part in a private networking session with drugs and explosives, digital, fire and analytical forensic scientists, as well as forensic science students Put your newfound knowledge to the test Have your burning questions answered by those in the know Receive valuable advice from experts in the field

curriculum_sections.title: Graduation & Certification
curriculum_sections.body: Graduation & Certification Celebrate everything you’ve achieved over the course of the programme and receive your industry reference letter signed by professionals outlining your accomplishments.

curriculum_sections.title: Immersive Experiences 2 Week Enhanced
curriculum_sections.body: Immersive Experiences 2 Week Enhanced Upgrade your 2-Week Summer Experience to Enhanced and gain an extra 15 hours of exclusive time with professionals and build a professional development portfolio to kickstart your future career. The 2-Week Enhanced option includes all the benefits and experiences of the first and second weeks, plus a weekend of extra career development opportunities and a private Gala dinner on the penultimate evening. The assessment to receive a Level 3 Award in Work Experience and UCAS points is also included.

curriculum_sections.title: Highlights
curriculum_sections.body: Highlights Participate in a series of expert professional development and university admissions masterclasses such as CV-writing, LinkedIn & personal branding, Oxbridge & Ivy League applications Undertake expert psychometric testing & personality profiling to develop your self-awareness and understand your core strengths, motivations and development areas Compete as a team in an assessed immersive strategy game Attend a private Gala dinner in central London with professionals, with keynote speeches and a networking reception Have your work assessed to receive a Level 3 Award in Work Experience and UCAS points to add to your university application.

description_full: Are you an aspiring political leader? Join our international politics summer school in London, designed for students aged 15-18. Over the course of two weeks, students will get to step into the shoes of a politician working in London, through a range of immersive career simulations and exclusive professional site visits. Represent your country in a model UN, run your own election campaign from start to finish and network with international political figures. Plus, gain a qualification in work experience to boost your university application! Register now for a life-changing experience that will set you up for a future as a successful politician or contact us to find out more.

curriculum_sections.title: The Model UN Experience
curriculum_sections.body: The Model UN Experience Breaking news! An international conflict has broken out. As a team, represent your country to ensure international stability, economic cooperation, trade supply lines and long standing alliances Discover diplomacy: understand the role of negotiation on the international stage Explore what determines a successful development intervention Work in teams to urgently deal with an evolving situation and race against the clock to build an effective international development strategy Receive expert feedback on your performance Take on the role as the UN Security Council to help solve an international conflict Learn about the UN’s famed cluster approach and see how nations work together in times of crisis

curriculum_sections.title: Becoming an Elected Official
curriculum_sections.body: Becoming an Elected Official In teams, design and run your own election campaign. See if you can build a manifesto, create a dazzling speech and win over voters! Build a manifesto for your campaign Address key issues relevant to your nation or constituents Examine the many forms of political strategy and evaluate the best ways to gain an advantage Manage your campaign and hone your approach to achieve electoral success Discover the inside tips and tricks for navigating political speeches Cultivate your power of persuasion and improve the clarity of your message as you perfect your pitch and delivery Work in your teams to canvass for deciding votes

curriculum_sections.title: Politics and the Media
curriculum_sections.body: Politics and the Media Visit Sky Up Academy Studios and receive a behind the scenes tour of Sky. Working in groups, take on the roles of the media team to create a political news report Discover how to craft a story when faced with political spin and legal limitations Receive live feedback from experts on how they would have handled the challenge Enter a crisis management simulation and understand the world of spin!

curriculum_sections.title: Campaigning and Lobbying
curriculum_sections.body: Campaigning and Lobbying Lobbying: what is it and what can we do? Discover the ways you can affect political change Take part in a campaign building masterclass Enter the lobby: Design and pitch your campaign!

curriculum_sections.title: Parliamentary Democracy
curriculum_sections.body: Parliamentary Democracy Visit one of the world’s most famous political buildings, the UK’s Houses of Parliament and understand 1,000 years of political history Now you’ve seen it in action, understand how bicameral parliamentary systems influence global politics Take your seat as the government or opposition and defend or criticise the handling of a crisis Form a government and tackle a complex and ever changing crisis Visit one of the world’s most famous political buildings, the UK’s Houses of Parliament and understand 1,000 years of political history

curriculum_sections.title: International Development and Conflict Resolution
curriculum_sections.body: International Development and Conflict Resolution Attend a Keynote Speech on International Development, Communications, secret technologies and problematic foreign aid Stop worldwide devastation: come up with answers to some dangerously problematic foreign policy Present your feedback and receive feedback from our industry executives Panel and Q&A with experts from all industries

description_full: Are you an aspiring investment banker? Join our investment banking summer school in London, designed for students aged 15-18. Throughout the programme students will have some of the most exclusive experiences of investment banking that one can imagine: trade the stock market with the London Academy of Trading, take part in a simulated M&A deal and build your own equities portfolio for review by an asset manager. Plus, gain a qualification in work experience to boost university and internship applications.Join us for a life-changing experience that will set you up for a future as a successful investment banker.

curriculum_sections.title: Overview
curriculum_sections.body: Overview Are you an aspiring investment banker? Join our investment banking summer school in London, designed for students aged 15-18. Throughout the programme students will have some of the most exclusive experiences of investment banking that one can imagine: trade the stock market with the London Academy of Trading, take part in a simulated M&A deal and build your own equities portfolio for review by an asset manager. Plus, gain a qualification in work experience to boost university and internship applications.Join us for a life-changing experience that will set you up for a future as a successful investment banker. Read all highights

curriculum_sections.title: The World of Sales & Trading
curriculum_sections.body: The World of Sales & Trading Discover the winning trading strategies employed by the world’s top investment bankers Learn how traders analyse volatile markets and how to understand the relationship between breaking news and prices Take part in a thrilling trading competition in teams to generate the highest return on investment Build your own equities portfolio Present your portfolio to hedge fund managers and get feedback on your investment

curriculum_sections.title: Uncovering Corporate Finance
curriculum_sections.body: Uncovering Corporate Finance Discover the fast-paced life of an M&A analyst at a global investment bank Learn how to calculate the value of any business using fundamental formulae Enter a live deal: compete to win a multi-million-pound merger and respond to live updates from your client as the pressure mounts Explore the high-powered world of IPOs alongside leading capital markets professionals

curriculum_sections.title: Become the Asset Manager
curriculum_sections.body: Become the Asset Manager Demystify the lucrative hedge fund industry with senior asset management professionals Take part in a state-of-the-art asset management simulation used by top investment banks to recruit their traders Compete against your peers as you manage a portfolio of global FX, commodity, equity and bond markets Receive personalised feedback on your performance and your ability to manage risk Delve into private equity and learn the strategies and techniques you’ll need to excel

curriculum_sections.title: Enter the Trading Floor
curriculum_sections.body: Enter the Trading Floor Learn the basics of fundamental and technical analysis Test your trading strategies and analysis skills as you complete with peers to navigate market shifts and maximise profits Receive feedback on your performance from experts with real-world trading experience Explore the realities of a day in the life on the trading floor

curriculum_sections.title: Pitching Workshop
curriculum_sections.body: Pitching Workshop Understand how to structure and deliver a compelling pitch Practice adapting your communication style to engage different audiences Learn how to present yourself confidently through vocal and body language coaching

curriculum_sections.title: Quant Finance
curriculum_sections.body: Quant Finance Understand key mathematical and statistical techniques used by quants, including modelling and data analysis Explore real-world examples of quantitative strategies Practice core Python functions and learn how these are used in investment banking

curriculum_sections.title: Venture Capital & Private Equity
curriculum_sections.body: Venture Capital & Private Equity Discover how venture capital firms invest in high-growth start-up businesses that can become the next multi-billion-dollar tech giants Learn how private equity firms drive profits Share your pitch with experienced investors and gain valuable insights

curriculum_sections.title: When Banking Breaks Down
curriculum_sections.body: When Banking Breaks Down Explore the causes and consequences of financial crashes and banking crises Learn how effective risk management can mitigate instability Understand the importance of protection policies, including insurance, regulations and contingency planning Step into the shoes of decision-makers in a case study debate

curriculum_sections.title: ESG & Ethical Investing
curriculum_sections.body: ESG & Ethical Investing Learn about the growing interest in Environmental, Social and Governance factors in our rapidly changing world Understand how to invest responsibly and generate returns

curriculum_sections.title: The Fintech Forum
curriculum_sections.body: The Fintech Forum Discover the exciting field of financial technology as you as you hear from a range of Fintech experts Compete in teams to come up with the next pioneering fintech company Collaborate with entrepreneurs and software engineers and assign project roles that reflect your areas of expertise Display your team’s project at an exclusive Fintech fair attended by industry-leading professionals and get feedback on your work

curriculum_sections.title: Networking Event with Top Investment Bankers
curriculum_sections.body: Networking Event with Top Investment Bankers Take part in a private networking session with top investment bankers across all sectors Put your newfound knowledge to the test Have your burning questions answered by those in the know Receive valuable advice from experts in the field

curriculum_sections.title: Career Coaching
curriculum_sections.body: Career Coaching Receive coaching on how to successfully break into banking Understand what it takes to secure spring weeks, internships and convert them into grad scheme offers Eye-catching extracurriculars: using extracurricular activities to stand out from the crowd and develop important skills for a career in investment banking Impactful work experience: learn the importance of securing relevant work experience and making the most of any opportunities Explore interview tips and tricks though an interactive workshop

curriculum_sections.title: Graduation & Certification
curriculum_sections.body: Graduation & Certification Celebrate everything you’ve achieved over the course of the programme and receive your industry reference letter signed by professionals outlining your accomplishments.

curriculum_sections.title: Immersive Experiences 2 Week Enhanced
curriculum_sections.body: Immersive Experiences 2 Week Enhanced Upgrade your 2-Week Summer Experience to Enhanced and gain an extra 15 hours of exclusive time with professionals and build a professional development portfolio to kickstart your future career. The 2-Week Enhanced option includes all the benefits and experiences of the first and second weeks, plus a weekend of extra career development opportunities and a private Gala dinner on the penultimate evening. The assessment to receive a Level 3 Award in Work Experience and UCAS points is also included.

curriculum_sections.title: Highlights
curriculum_sections.body: Highlights Participate in a series of expert professional development and university admissions masterclasses such as CV-writing, LinkedIn & personal branding, Oxbridge & Ivy League applications Undertake expert psychometric testing & personality profiling to develop your self-awareness and understand your core strengths, motivations and development areas Compete as a team in an assessed immersive strategy game Attend a private Gala dinner in central London with professionals, with keynote speeches and a networking reception Have your work assessed to receive a Level 3 Award in Work Experience and UCAS points to add to your university application.

Over the course of 2 weeks, students aged 15-18 will get to step into the shoes of a lawyer working in London, through a range of immersive career simulations and exclusive professional site visits. curriculum_sections.title: The Murder Trial
curriculum_sections.body: The Murder Trial Entre the world of criminal law by following a simulated trial from arrest through to verdict over two days You will represent either prosecution or defence and act as a lawyer in the proceedings Review initial police disclosures, discuss interview strategy and represent the police or the defendants during the live police interview Act out an application for bail Make closing and opening court speeches Cross-examine witnesses Feedback from real criminal lawyers

curriculum_sections.title: Corporate Law
curriculum_sections.body: Corporate Law Step into the shoes of a corporate lawyer in the city Learn from top corporate lawyers and understand the skills you need Corporate law simulation: enter a legal negotiation on behalf of an international company wanting to acquire another Receive live feedback from expert corporate lawyers on your negotiation approach

curriculum_sections.title: Family Law
curriculum_sections.body: Family Law Analyse a high-profile divorce case and decide the correct legal advice Serve as the family lawyer representing the clients at trial Read and interpret expert witness statements and forensic evidence Defend your client’s wishes and try to get the best outcome for them Receive live feedback from family lawyers on your performance

curriculum_sections.title: Human Rights: Enter The Supreme Court
curriculum_sections.body: Human Rights: Enter The Supreme Court Over the course of two days, you will immerse yourself in human rights law by engaging with essential human rights, advocacy coaching and culminating in advocating for your client in a ground-breaking human rights case. Meet professionals fighting to protect human rights around the world The Power of Law: discover the ways in which law can be used to address and tackle societal issues and concerns Coaching by expert barristers on how to become a powerful public speaker Learn key advocacy techniques: refining arguments, using body language, selecting particular words for emphasis and perfecting and varying your intonation Analyse a high-profile human rights case and prepare to advocate for your client Deliver your legal submissions in the Supreme Court, with a barrister acting as a judge Receive feedback from expert advocates on your performance

curriculum_sections.title: Public Law
curriculum_sections.body: Public Law Meet public law experts and learn about the ways in which law touches all areas of life Work in teams looking into a suspicious death in police custody Defend the public in a nationwide public inquiry in medical malpractice

curriculum_sections.title: International Law and Treaty Negotiation
curriculum_sections.body: International Law and Treaty Negotiation Understand the high-profile world of international law Conflict scenario: an international conflict has broken out and a compromise needs to be achieved Come up with the best-case scenario for your allotted country Negotiate and fight for treaty terms Consider key areas such as: human rights protection, education and international trade

curriculum_sections.body: Educational Psychology Discover the realities of working with vulnerable young people and get insider tips from experienced professionals Take on the case of a child who is struggling at school and carry out your own assessment Take part in a simulated consultation with a parent and develop the key communication skills needed to support the child’s learning development Use what you’ve learnt to develop an intervention plan and get feedback from qualified experts

curriculum_sections.title: Enter the Psych Clinic
curriculum_sections.body: Enter the Psych Clinic Learn the key skills and techniques employed by clinical psychologists Discover the fundamentals of patient interaction: building trust, establishing rapport and active listening Become the psychologist: carry out an initial assessment with a variety of patients and develop bespoke treatment plans Explore Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) and use specialised techniques with your patients

curriculum_sections.title: Sport Psychology
curriculum_sections.body: Sport Psychology Tour a premier league stadium and walk in the footsteps of world-renowned athletes and sports psychologists Understand the key to match-day preparation and recognise the athlete’s critical pitfalls Undertake a private conversation with a professional athlete about how sports psychology has impacted their performance Explore tools that enhance player concentration and promote resilience on and off the pitch

curriculum_sections.title: Forensic Psychology
curriculum_sections.body: Forensic Psychology Assess the psychological state of a criminal in a simulated criminal case Carry out psychometric assessments on the offender and find out the cognitive and behavioural factors that led to the offence Enter the courtroom: take to the stand and testify as an expert witness Devise a treatment plan for the convicted criminal: facilitate a prison therapy session and evaluate the prisoner’s rehabilitation progress Consult with a parole board and make the final decision on whether the prisoner should qualify for early release

curriculum_sections.title: How to Become a Successful Psychologist
curriculum_sections.body: How to Become a Successful Psychologist Your path to success: understanding the key decisions ahead and how to maximise your chances of success Making the right subject choices: A-level/IB/university and beyond Building an outstanding university application Securing work experience and designing an impactful CV Powerful interview techniques Coaching from experienced psychologists on how to stand out from the crowd

curriculum_sections.title: Enter the Mental Health Ward
curriculum_sections.body: Enter the Mental Health Ward Explore a simulated in-patient ward Discover pioneering therapy techniques: art, drama and movement therapies Work collaboratively with a team of psychologists, nurses and doctors in a multidisciplinary meeting to support your patient Work with your medical team to diffuse an alarming situation and ensure the psychological safety of your patients Devise a crisis plan with a patient showing schizophrenic symptoms to manage negative emotions

curriculum_sections.title: Inside the Nervous System
curriculum_sections.body: Inside the Nervous System Discover how cognition and behaviour are inextricably linked to brain function Become the assessor and facilitate a neurological assessment Case study: work alongside clinical neuropsychologists to ascertain the impact of a traumatic brain injury on a patient’s everyday function and cognition

curriculum_sections.title: Visit Bethlem Royal Hospital
curriculum_sections.body: Visit Bethlem Royal Hospital Take a private tour of the UK’s oldest mental illness hospital Gain a unique insight into the history of mental health care and treatment Explore a renowned collection of archives, art and historic objects Understand the significance of labelling and diagnosis, freedom and constraint, temperament, treatments and recovery in an ethical debate Talk with the anxiety disorder referral unit and hear first hand patient experience

curriculum_sections.title: Occupational and Business Psychology
curriculum_sections.body: Occupational and Business Psychology Journey to the heart of corporate London and uncover how psychology underpins successful businesses CEO or psychopath? Explore different behaviours and personality types found in the workplace and analyse what these mean for getting ahead Humanising business: develop thoughtful solutions to social problems using behavioural science Design your own behavioural experiment and carry it out with your peers Analyse the results before pitching your findings to top business psychologists

curriculum_sections.title: The Future of Psychology
curriculum_sections.body: The Future of Psychology Meet with a pioneering PsychTech firm and discover how Cyberpsychologists are helping people master their minds with cutting-edge technology Step into the virtual world and collaborate with your peers in a group assessment task Explore how Virtual Reality can help patients with struggling trauma, phobias, addiction, pain management, ADHD symptoms and more

curriculum_sections.title: Networking Event with Top Psychologists
curriculum_sections.body: Networking Event with Top Psychologists Take part in a private networking session with senior psychologists, trainee psychologists and current psychology students Have your burning questions answered by those in the know Receive valuable advice from experts in the field

curriculum_sections.title: Graduation & Certification
curriculum_sections.body: Graduation & Certification Celebrate everything you’ve achieved over the course of the programme and receive your industry reference letter signed by professionals outlining your accomplishments.

curriculum_sections.title: Immersive Experiences 2 Week Enhanced
curriculum_sections.body: Immersive Experiences 2 Week Enhanced Upgrade your 2-Week Summer Experience to Enhanced and gain an extra 15 hours of exclusive time with professionals and build a professional development portfolio to kickstart your future career. The 2-Week Enhanced option includes all the benefits and experiences of the first and second weeks, plus a weekend of extra career development opportunities and a private Gala dinner on the penultimate evening. The assessment to receive a Level 3 Award in Work Experience and UCAS points is also included.

curriculum_sections.title: Highlights
curriculum_sections.body: Highlights Participate in a series of expert professional development and university admissions masterclasses such as CV-writing, LinkedIn & personal branding, Oxbridge & Ivy League applications Undertake expert psychometric testing & personality profiling to develop your self-awareness and understand your core strengths, motivations and development areas Compete as a team in an assessed immersive strategy game Attend a private Gala dinner in central London with professionals, with keynote speeches and a networking reception Have your work assessed to receive a Level 3 Award in Work Experience and UCAS points to add to your university application.

curriculum_sections.title: On Set: Producing, Directing and Filming
curriculum_sections.body: On Set: Producing, Directing and Filming Understand the role of a producer: securing locations, building a team and making the film happen Step into the shoes of a director: coach professional actors through a scene Put your videography skills to the test as you film your own movie scene Choose the right shots, angles and lighting and make crucial decisions on set design, lighting, sound, costume, make up and props

curriculum_sections.title: Post-Production: The Editing Suite
curriculum_sections.body: Post-Production: The Editing Suite Witness a live demonstration of editing by an industry expert with cutting edge software Learn professional techniques and apply them to your work Edit your scene together with your team making artistic decisions about sound, transition, speed and cuts Discover the power of colour grading, sound, composition, foley artistry and more Transform your raw footage into a scene suitable for a slick motion picture

curriculum_sections.title: Bespoke Feedback and Career Coaching
curriculum_sections.body: Bespoke Feedback and Career Coaching Receive personal feedback on your work from various film professionals University or Film School: Top career advice from recent industry graduates on the best choice for you Explore a wide range of industry roles that make your favourite pieces of media a reality Network with like-minded peers with a passion for TV and film

curriculum_sections.title: Plan and Shoot a Music Video
curriculum_sections.body: Plan and Shoot a Music Video Develop your skills in a different medium as you are hired to shoot a music video Work collaboratively with your peers to decide on a song and craft your story Plan a comprehensive storyboard and shot list, then turn them into polished shots Focus on cuts, transitions, copy, sound and colour in order to transform your raw footage into an industry-standard music video Premiere your video to industry professionals and present the reasoning behind your creative decisions Get live feedback from the experts and take on board their advice

curriculum_sections.title: Short Form Content and Marketing
curriculum_sections.body: Short Form Content and Marketing Advertisement and short form content as a stepping stone to your career Create your very own ad for a fictitious product Understand the importance of market research and how it can shape your project Plan, shoot and edit your very own short scene using virtual production technology Live Q&A with the team of technicians behind the scenes

curriculum_sections.title: Experience Live Broadcasting at a TV studio
curriculum_sections.body: Experience Live Broadcasting at a TV studio Step behind the scenes and immerse yourself in the fast-paced world of live television production Work collaboratively with your peers as you take on key studio roles - from camera operation and presenting to directing and floor management Learn how to plan, rehearse and deliver a professional live broadcast under real studio conditions Gain hands on experience with industry standard equipment and discover how timing, teamwork and communication shape live TV

curriculum_sections.title: The Young Filmmaker Festival
curriculum_sections.body: The Young Filmmaker Festival From Short to Silver Screen: compete for awards at our exclusive film festival! Experience your own work on the big screen in a real-life cinema Watch a selection of films from the Summer Experience and unpick the creative choices made Critically reflect upon what you have seen and use this as a frame of reference for your later career Compete against your peers for top prizes at the festival awards ceremony

curriculum_sections.title: The World of a Vet
curriculum_sections.body: The World of a Vet Explore the different career paths in veterinary science Explore the differences between domestic and wild animal care Working in a practice vs. working out in the field Where to take your residencies: private practices or academic institutions? Hear from professional vets on the highs and lows of the job Gain insights into the skills you’ll need to succeed

curriculum_sections.title: Enter The Small Animal Practice
curriculum_sections.body: Enter The Small Animal Practice Perform clinical examinations, diagnose patients and tend to their needs Learn the basics of first aid and practise CPR on a dummy animal Work through a series of case studies and come up with proper diagnosis and treatment for each Learn vital communication skills that will help you build rapport with pet owners Gain valuable feedback from vet surgeons on your interaction with clients and your treatment plans

curriculum_sections.title: The Farm Vet
curriculum_sections.body: The Farm Vet Discover the vital role vets play in managing farm animals and protecting our public health Observe how farm vets care for cattle and other large animals Explore the role farm vets have in advising and supporting farmers Examine the routine tests performed in a farm: taking blood, providing treatment and performing ultrasound and TB tests Learn about the importance of preventative care, nutrition and behaviour to ensure the long-term health of farm animals

curriculum_sections.title: Become an Equine Specialist
curriculum_sections.body: Become an Equine Specialist Observe the unique relationship between veterinary staff and horses Learn the responsibilities of an equine vet and the importance of rehabilitation Explore the different treatment methods equine vets use to treat ailing horses Examine different work avenues: private breeders, race horse owners and research facilities Work alongside equine vets and horses to understand the joys of this prestigious field

curriculum_sections.title: Vet School Applications
curriculum_sections.body: Vet School Applications Subject choices at A-level/IB/university and more Securing work experience Model UCAS personal statements Powerful interview techniques Choosing the right course and veterinary school Your journey through veterinary school The challenges facing veterinary applicants Coaching from experienced vets on what you can do to stand out

curriculum_sections.title: Animal Surgery
curriculum_sections.body: Animal Surgery Understand the role of surgery in animal hospitals Learn the 3 main procedural categories – orthopaedics, soft tissue surgery and neurosurgery Practise making a diagnosis and decide the next steps to save an animal’s life in a series of case studies Test dexterity skills through simulated surgical activities Undertake a common vet surgery procedure using everyday household items under the guidance of an experienced surgeon

curriculum_sections.title: The Wildlife Vet
curriculum_sections.body: The Wildlife Vet Examine the duties of a wildlife vet: examinations, vaccinations and treatments Understand the role of vets in ensuring the preservation of wildlife health in a mega-city Get hands-on with exotic animals and speak to the team who look after them every day Respond to ‘what you would do’ scenarios on controversial issues of captivity Into the wild: visit a top wildlife attraction and learn about the future of animal conservation

curriculum_sections.title: Digital Health and Veterinary Ethics
curriculum_sections.body: Digital Health and Veterinary Ethics Explore the use of telemedicine in veterinary practices Examine how client consultations can be improved using digital health technology Navigate controversial topics in veterinary ethics including declawing, euthanasia and selective breeding The duty of care: explore what constitutes animal cruelty beyond animal abuse Learn the progressive code of ethical conduct that all vet professionals should adhere to

curriculum_sections.title: A Day in the Life of a Hospital Vet
curriculum_sections.body: A Day in the Life of a Hospital Vet Conduct a mini ‘ward round’ and complete daily tasks a hospital vet would undertake Complete simulated surgical activities with the support of experts Respond to ‘what you would do’ scenarios when dealing with severe rehabilitation cases Apply this knowledge to strengthen veterinary school interview performance

curriculum_sections.title: Networking Event With Top Vets
curriculum_sections.body: Networking Event With Top Vets Take part in a private networking session with specialist vets and veterinary students Have your burning questions answered by those in the know Receive valuable advice from experts in the field

curriculum_sections.title: Graduation & Certification
curriculum_sections.body: Graduation & Certification Celebrate everything you’ve achieved over the course of the programme and receive your industry reference letter signed by professionals outlining your accomplishments.

curriculum_sections.title: Immersive Experiences 2 Week Enhanced
curriculum_sections.body: Immersive Experiences 2 Week Enhanced Upgrade your 2-Week Summer Experience to Enhanced and gain an extra 15 hours of exclusive time with professionals and build a professional development portfolio to kickstart your future career. The 2-Week Enhanced option includes all the benefits and experiences of the first and second weeks, plus a weekend of extra career development opportunities and a private Gala dinner on the penultimate evening. The assessment to receive a Level 3 Award in Work Experience and UCAS points is also included.

curriculum_sections.title: Highlights
curriculum_sections.body: Highlights Participate in a series of expert professional development and university admissions masterclasses such as CV-writing, LinkedIn & personal branding, Oxbridge & Ivy League applications Undertake expert psychometric testing & personality profiling to develop your self-awareness and understand your core strengths, motivations and development areas Compete as a team in an assessed immersive strategy game Attend a private Gala dinner in central London with professionals, with keynote speeches and a networking reception Have your work assessed to receive a Level 3 Award in Work Experience and UCAS points to add to your university application.

An Architecture & Design Summer School with Oxford Royale lets you explore how history, creativity and innovation shape the built world. From concept to construction, you’ll develop your ideas through hands-on model-making, technical drawing, site analysis and design challenges. We’ll help you to build the practical skills, creative confidence and critical thinking that define great architects.In Cambridge, your classroom extends far beyond the studio. Surrounded by centuries of iconic architecture and world-changing ideas, experience a city where historic colleges stand alongside bold contemporary design. Through site visits and expert-led sessions, you’ll learn within a living showcase of architectural inspiration: an unforgettable setting to imagine, design and create. Whether you’re an aspiring coder or simply tech-curious, you’ll build AI applications, explore cryptography and examine how cyber attacks happen — and how to prevent them. Living and studying in the colleges of the University of Cambridge, you’ll experience student life in a world-renowned centre of innovation — seeing how ideas move from campus to real-world impact. title: Explore Law in Cambridge
subject: Law
description_short: Explore Law at Oxford Royale’s summer school in Cambridge for ages 12–15—creative projects, supportive tutors & an inspiring university setting.
description_full: Explore Law at Oxford Royale’s summer school in Cambridge for ages 12–15—creative projects, supportive tutors & an inspiring university setting.

curriculum_sections.body: Why attend a Law Summer School? An Explore Law Summer School with Oxford Royale invites you into the world of justice, debate and legal reasoning in a hands-on, interactive environment. You’ll develop foundational legal skills, strengthen your ability to argue and analyse and discover what it means to understand and uphold the law. Working alongside ambitious peers from around the world, you’ll build confidence in presenting ideas and thinking critically.Based in the colleges of the University of Cambridge, you’ll live and study on campus in one of the world’s most prestigious university cities. Walking through historic courts that have shaped influential thinkers and leaders, you’ll experience student life in a setting defined by tradition, achievement and big ideas. Step Into the World of Law Experience the world of law first-hand on this immersive course. Explore criminal, civil and international law through interactive workshops, mock trials, debates and real-world case studies that challenge you to think critically and argue persuasively.Live in Cambridge’s historic colleges, connect with ambitious students from around the world and gain practical insight into what it takes to reason, advocate and lead within a field that shapes society and upholds justice.Learn to think like a lawyerDaily hands-on projectsEngaging Expert TeachersMock Trial Exhibition Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale. View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideYusuf OlalereMScYusuf is an Associate in the Corporate Practice, working from London while supporting the New York team. He holds an MSc in Law & Finance from the University of Oxford, giving him a strong interdisciplinary grounding in both legal and financial aspects of complex corporate transactions. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Group Projects Work as a legal team to prepare and deliver a full mock trial, taking on roles as barristers, witnesses and jurors to explore a fictional murder case from evidence to verdict. Workshops Negotiate and draft a written constitution for a fictional nation, deciding on government structures, justice systems and fundamental rights. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Trusted by parents and students alike Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Hear From Our Students“ Oxford Royale Academy gave me an insight into a university course I was very interested in and helped me decide I wanted to do that for sure. Apart from the great academic courses the activities were extremely enjoyable and unforgettable. I really recommend ORA to everyone who wants to gain an insight into what university is like.”ClaudiaCambridgeHear from Our Parents“The classes were very different from school. We had the hands-on experiences that are really important for learning the subject and it’s helped me decide what I want to do in the future. ”MariaEngineering“In school, we mostly learn simpler topics, but these classes were different. The lessons went much more in depth and I found them fascinating. If this is what university-level learning is like, I definitely want to go to university. I’ve really enjoyed the experience and I hope university will be just like this.”NicolasExperimental PsychologyPrevious slideNext slide An unforgettable summer Exploring Cambridge feels like stepping into centuries of discovery and innovation. Our excursions help students experience the city’s rich academic heritage through guided tours, college visits and riverside highlights - plus an optional London trip for anyone wanting even more adventure.Guided walking tours around historic Cambridge landmarksVisits to renowned colleges, libraries and heritage sitesExploration of Market Square, scenic quads and riverside pathsOptional full-day London excursion for a capital-city experience Make connections to last a lifetime The social programme in Cambridge blends creativity, culture and connection. subject: Artificial Intelligence & Technology
description_short: Explore Python at Oxford Royale’s summer school in Cambridge for ages 12–15—hands-on projects, supportive tutors & an inspiring university setting.
description_full: Explore Python at Oxford Royale’s summer school in Cambridge for ages 12–15—hands-on projects, supportive tutors & an inspiring university setting.

curriculum_sections.body: Why attend a Python Coding Summer School? An Explore Python Coding Summer School with Oxford Royale helps you understand the technology shaping today’s world. You’ll develop coding, problem-solving and logical thinking skills as you move from writing your first lines of code to building your own projects. Through hands-on challenges and collaboration, you’ll gain the confidence to create with technology — not just use it.Based in the colleges of the University of Cambridge, you’ll live and study on campus in one of the world’s most inspiring academic cities. Walking through historic courts that have shaped generations of innovators and scientists, you’ll experience student life in a setting defined by creativity, ambition and discovery. Step Into the World of Python & AI Step into the world of programming and digital innovation as you learn how code powers the technologies shaping modern life. From your very first lines of Python to building interactive projects, you will explore how programmers think, solve problems and create intelligent systems. Through hands-on learning and real-world examples, you’ll gain the confidence to understand and shape, the digital world around you.Whether you’re just starting out or already passionate about coding, this course caters to all levels and develops a deep, practical understanding.Hands-on Python Coding SessionsTeam-based Learning ExperienceInteractive Programming WorkshopsCreative Coding & Game Design ProjectsProblem-Solving & Debugging ChallengesCapstone Project ShowcaseLearn from Expert Coding Instructors Download the course guide EmailSubmit What will your course look like View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideDr Ameer JabaniResearcherDr Ameer Janabi is a researcher at the University of Cambridge and an entrepreneur in electric mobility and power electronics. He founded Hardcore Power Electronics in the United States, now partnered with FEV North America and Cambridge Integration in the United Kingdom, which is developing integrated approaches to power electronics. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Group Projects Plan and build your own coding project; from a marine biology simulation to a game or interactive app, designing your data flow, anticipating bugs and presenting your finished work to the class. Workshops Hands-on classes designed to help students learn through practical application. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Creative Projects Design and build games, simulations, or interactive applications that bring programming concepts to life. Trusted by parents and students alike Hear From Our Students“ Oxford Royale Academy gave me an insight into a university course I was very interested in and helped me decide I wanted to do that for sure. Apart from the great academic courses the activities were extremely enjoyable and unforgettable. I really recommend ORA to everyone who wants to gain an insight into what university is like.”ClaudiaCambridgeHear from Our Parents“The classes were very different from school. We had the hands-on experiences that are really important for learning the subject and it’s helped me decide what I want to do in the future. ”MariaEngineering“In school, we mostly learn simpler topics, but these classes were different. The lessons went much more in depth and I found them fascinating. If this is what university-level learning is like, I definitely want to go to university. I’ve really enjoyed the experience and I hope university will be just like this.”NicolasExperimental PsychologyPrevious slideNext slide An unforgettable summer Exploring Cambridge feels like stepping into centuries of discovery and innovation. Our excursions help students experience the city’s rich academic heritage through guided tours, college visits and riverside highlights - plus an optional London trip for anyone wanting even more adventure.Guided walking tours around historic Cambridge landmarksVisits to renowned colleges, libraries and heritage sitesExploration of Market Square, scenic quads and riverside pathsOptional full-day London excursion for a capital-city experience Make connections to last a lifetime The social programme in Cambridge blends creativity, culture and connection. title: Law & Politics in Cambridge
subject: Law
description_short: Study Law & Politics at Oxford Royale’s summer school in Cambridge for ages 16–18—creative projects, supportive tutors & an inspiring university setting.
description_full: Study Law & Politics at Oxford Royale’s summer school in Cambridge for ages 16–18—creative projects, supportive tutors & an inspiring university setting.

curriculum_sections.body: Why attend a Law Summer School? A Law & Summer School with Oxford Royale offers an immersive, hands-on exploration of legal systems and political processes. You’ll build practical skills through case studies, debates and mock trials, developing the confidence and critical thinking needed to analyse complex issues. Alongside ambitious peers from around the world, you’ll deepen your understanding of how laws are created, interpreted and upheld.Hosted by Oxford Royale at Clare College, Cambridge, the programme allows you to live and learn in one of the world’s most historic centres of legal and political thought. While studying with Oxford Royale, you’ll experience life on campus in this renowned university city — an inspiring setting that brings the study of law to life. Step Into the World of Law Experience the world of law first-hand on this immersive course. Explore criminal, civil and international law through interactive workshops, mock trials, debates and real-world case studies that challenge you to think critically and argue persuasively.Live in Cambridge’s historic colleges, connect with ambitious students from around the world and gain practical insight into what it takes to reason, advocate and lead within a field that shapes society and upholds justice.Learn to think like a lawyerDaily hands-on projectsEngaging Expert TeachersMock Trial Exhibition Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideYusuf OlalereMScYusuf is an Associate in the Corporate Practice, working from London while supporting the New York team. He holds an MSc in Law & Finance from the University of Oxford, giving him a strong interdisciplinary grounding in both legal and financial aspects of complex corporate transactions. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Group Projects Take on the roles of barristers, witnesses and jurors in a full mock murder trial; constructing arguments, cross-examining witnesses and delivering a verdict under real courtroom pressure. Workshops Represent one of 20 nations in a global climate change policy simulation. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. curriculum_sections.title: Why this program
curriculum_sections.body: Why attend a Medicine Summer School? A Medicine Summer School with Oxford Royale offers an immersive introduction to the science and practice of healthcare. Through hands-on classes in biology, anatomy, genetics, neuroscience and emergency medicine, you’ll explore how the human body works and how doctors diagnose and treat disease. Guided by expert tutors and medical professionals, you’ll gain insight into medical pathways, from the expectations of undergraduate study to diverse areas of specialisation.Cambridge is one of the world’s most influential centres of scientific discovery — the city where the structure of DNA was uncovered and where medical breakthroughs continue today. While studying with Oxford Royale, you’ll live and learn in the colleges of the University of Cambridge, experiencing campus life in a city synonymous with innovation, research and advancement in medicine. Step Into the World of Medicine Want to step into medicine? Study anatomy, diagnosis and patient care, then practise your skills in simulations - with state of the art medical training equipment - designed to feel like the real thing. Medicine is more than memorising facts. Learn architecture with Oxford Royale from concept to construction through creative challenges, model-making and technical drawing, building the skills to bring your ideas to life.Be inspired by the beating heart of the UK, where modern innovation and historic architecture come together. From palaces to skyscrapers, your time on campus at Imperial College London, the city’s best university, will ignite your passion for architecture and help you master design. Step Into the World of Architecture Explore the evolution of design from Ancient Greece to modern London while developing skills in technical drawing, mapping and model-making. Tackle a “City of the Future” project, learn from expert tutors and discover your architectural interests.Build a portfolio, collaborate with ambitious peers and enjoy life in London, with its museums, culture and world-leading creative inspiration.Site Visits and MappingUrban Planning ChallengeEmerging Design TechnologiesEngaging Expert TeachersBe Inspired By London Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale. Session 1 students will arrive on the Monday. Please see a sample timetable here. View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideLana Al-ShamiMALana graduated with a Master of Arts with distinction before qualifying as an Architect in 2007. She has lectured in Architecture and Interior Architecture and Design at university in London. She has a keen interest in sustainable development and conservation and has worked on many award winning buildings throughout her career. Lana is also an artist and designer and has exhibited her work around the UK as well as internationally. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Group Projects Design a house and studio for a violin maker, producing sketches, technical drawings, physical and digital models and a full design proposal, culminating in a final crit presentation to the class. Workshops Join a professional architect on a walking tour of Battersea Power Station and Nine Elms with a live drawing task. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Trusted by parents and students alike From the first day to the last, our students discover the best version of themselves. Read their stories and see why Oxford Royale leaves a mark that lasts a lifetime. Hear From Our Students“Here at Oxford Royale, having a diverse mix of classmates helped me build up my argument and debating skills and how to communicate across cultures. Everything I’ve learned here will help me in my future studies, especially when it comes to choosing my research topics. ”YashviOxford Royale AlumHear from Our Parents“The classes were very different from school. We had the hands-on experiences that are really important for learning the subject and it’s helped me decide what I want to do in the future. ”MariaEngineering“I chose to come to Oxford Royale because I wanted an adventure! I also wanted to explore university life and learn more about the subject. I love the lessons here because the teachers make the lessons fun while teaching, lots of practical work.”FemiExplore Engineering“In school, we mostly learn simpler topics, but these classes were different. The lessons went much more in depth and I found them fascinating. If this is what university-level learning is like, I definitely want to go to university. I’ve really enjoyed the experience and I hope university will be just like this.”NicolasExperimental PsychologyPrevious slideNext slide Make connections to last a lifetime The social scene in London is full of possibilities. Students can expect creative workshops, group outings, relaxed welcome events and evenings exploring local culture - all set against the buzz of one of the world’s most exciting cities.Creative workshops that spark collaboration and fresh ideasGroup outings to museums, galleries and riverside destinationsWelcome activities that help everyone connect from day oneDebate society and grand finalFun social opportunities woven into city life

From micro to macro, explore how economics shapes everything. Learn to think like an economist and act like a strategist.London is a global centre for economics, finance and policymaking — an ideal environment to deepen your understanding of how markets shape the world. Studying on campus at Imperial College London places you at the heart of one of the world’s most influential financial ecosystems, where theory meets real-world impact. Step Into the World of Economics and Finance Explore supply and demand, market structures, growth, inflation and unemployment while seeing how economies work in practice. Tackle simulations and trading exercises to master real-world financial skills.
