title: Medicine in London
subject: Medicine
description_short: Study Medicine at Oxford Royale’s summer school in London for ages 16–18—creative projects, supportive tutors & an inspiring university setting.
description_full: Study Medicine at Oxford Royale’s summer school in London for ages 16–18—creative projects, supportive tutors & an inspiring university setting.

curriculum_sections.body: Why Attend a Medicine Summer School? Want to step into medicine? With Oxford Royale study anatomy, diagnosis and patient care, then practise your skills in simulations designed to feel real. Medicine is more than memorising facts. Learn to think critically, act decisively and care for patients through hands on practice and teamwork.London is a world-leading centre for medicine, research and clinical innovation — the city where penicillin was first discovered. Studying medicine on campus at Imperial College London places you within one of the UK’s most dynamic clinical and research environments, at the forefront of scientific discovery and patient care. Step Into the World of Medicine Study anatomy and physiology, practise examinations and sharpen your diagnostic skills through realistic simulations. Think and act like a doctor while exploring careers from surgeon to researcher. Learn from experienced medics, build confidence and teamwork and spend two weeks in London, discovering world-class museums, culture and life with ambitious peers.Build skills for future medical careerLearn how to diagnose and treatUnderstand human anatomyLearn from case studies and simulationsEngaging Expert Teachers Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideDr Claire KeeneMSc, PhDDr Claire Keene is a public health clinician with a masters in International Health and Tropical Medicine from the University of Oxford. She is an experienced clinical trial manager, formerly managing a Médecins Sans Frontières project on HIV and tuberculosis. Dr Claire Keene MSc, PhD Dr Claire Keene is a public health clinician with a masters in International Health and Tropical Medicine from the University of Oxford. She is an experienced clinical trial manager, formerly managing a Médecins Sans Frontières project on HIV and tuberculosis. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Group Projects Take on a real clinical skills assessment; taking a patient's history, outlining an examination and presenting a diagnosis and management plan under exam conditions. Workshops Try advanced medical diagnostic equipment from ultrasound and ECGs to suturing, blood-taking and keyhole surgery in a hands-on clinical skills workshop. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Trusted by parents and students alike From the first day to the last, our students discover the best version of themselves. Read their stories and see why Oxford Royale leaves a mark that lasts a lifetime. Hear From Our Students“Here at Oxford Royale, having a diverse mix of classmates helped me build up my argument and debating skills and how to communicate across cultures. Everything I’ve learned here will help me in my future studies, especially when it comes to choosing my research topics. ”YashviOxford Royale AlumHear from Our Parents“The classes were very different from school. We had the hands-on experiences that are really important for learning the subject and it’s helped me decide what I want to do in the future. ”MariaEngineering“I chose to come to Oxford Royale because I wanted an adventure! I also wanted to explore university life and learn more about the subject. I love the lessons here because the teachers make the lessons fun while teaching, lots of practical work.”FemiExplore Engineering“In school, we mostly learn simpler topics, but these classes were different. The lessons went much more in depth and I found them fascinating. If this is what university-level learning is like, I definitely want to go to university. I’ve really enjoyed the experience and I hope university will be just like this.”NicolasExperimental PsychologyPrevious slideNext slide Make connections to last a lifetime The social scene in London is full of possibilities. subject: Architecture
description_short: Study Architecture & Design at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 16–18—creative projects, expert tutors & an inspiring Oxford setting.
description_full: Study Architecture & Design at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 16–18—creative projects, expert tutors & an inspiring Oxford setting.

curriculum_sections.body: Why Attend an Architecture Summer School? Architecture is creativity in action, where history, design and innovation meet. Learn architecture from concept to construction through creative challenges, model-making and technical drawing, building the skills to bring your ideas to life. Step Into the World of Architecture Step into the world of architecture, exploring how ideas become structures through creative challenges, model-making and technical drawing. Discover design across history, learn to map sites and build models and experiment with colour and form. With hands-on practice and inspiring surroundings, you’ll develop the skills to bring bold architectural concepts to life.Bring architecture to life in one of the UK's most architecturally outstanding cities.Oxford Architecture ToursSite Visits and MappingEngaging Expert TeachersEmerging Design TechnologiesModel BuildingUrban Planning ChallengeSustainable City Project Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideLana Al-ShamiMALana graduated with a Master of Arts with distinction before qualifying as an Architect in 2007. She has lectured in Architecture and Interior Architecture and Design at university in London. She has a keen interest in sustainable development and conservation and has worked on many award winning buildings throughout her career. Lana is also an artist and designer and has exhibited her work around the UK as well as internationally. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. Group Projects Design a house and studio for a violin maker, producing sketches, technical drawings, physical and digital models and a full design proposal, culminating in a final crit presentation to the class. Workshops Explore colour psychology, follow the timeline of an interior design project and create an inspiration board in response to a client brief (Session 1 & 3). Work on a real client brief to create, design and present your own interior concept using professional tools and techniques (Session 2). How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Make connections to last a lifetime Our social programme is all about connection, creativity and giving students space to try new things. description_short: Study at the Oxford Royale’s summer school for Film Academy, for ages 16–18—creative projects, expert tutors & an inspiring Oxford setting.
description_full: Study at the Oxford Royale’s summer school for Film Academy, for ages 16–18—creative projects, expert tutors & an inspiring Oxford setting.

curriculum_sections.body: Step Into the World of Film Master professional filmmaking by learning to use HD cameras, sound and lighting to bring your vision to life. Develop expert editing skills with Final Cut Pro and take your film through post-production. Then work in teams to create a full production package and pitch your story to a live audience for GreenLight approval.Group Research & PresentationsDaily Hands-On ProjectsEngaging Expert TeachersLearn on professional camera and equipmentPractise digital editing skills using Final Cut ProWork with film industry expertsDirect, shoot and edit a film from scratch Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideBruce WindwoodFilmmaker Windwood is a multi-award winning filmmaker with credits including the comedy feature film 12 In A Box. Bruce is a commissioned writer for TV and audio as well as a composer for film, audio and TV soundtracks. Having helped to design, develop and expand ORA’s filmmaking classes over the last 11 years, Bruce is one of the most senior tutors. He also regularly teaches short and long-form filmmaking at the prestigious National Film & TV School as well as Film Oxford. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Group Projects Work as a real film crew to produce, shoot and edit your own short film over two weeks, taking ownership of your scenes and seeing your vision come to life on screen. Workshops Pitch an original film or TV series to the class in a Hollywood-style pitch session, developing your premise, characters and marketing angles before facing a live Q&A. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Trusted by parents and students alike Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. I have met so many people from all over the world and I have made some lifelong friends. ”LauraBusiness, Innovation & EntrepreneurshipHear from Our Parents“The classes were very different from school. We had the hands-on experiences that are really important for learning the subject and it’s helped me decide what I want to do in the future. ”MariaEngineering“I chose to come to Oxford Royale because I wanted an adventure! I also wanted to explore university life and learn more about the subject. I love the lessons here because the teachers make the lessons fun while teaching, lots of practical work.”FemiExplore Engineering“In school, we mostly learn simpler topics, but these classes were different. The lessons went much more in depth and I found them fascinating. If this is what university-level learning is like, I definitely want to go to university. I’ve really enjoyed the experience and I hope university will be just like this.”NicolasExperimental PsychologyPrevious slideNext slide Make connections to last a lifetime Our social programme is all about connection, creativity and giving students space to try new things. From punting and hands-on workshops to debate evenings, gallery visits and relaxed welcome events, there’s always something inspiring happening after classes.Punting on the Cherwell with friendsCreative workshops designed to spark imagination and confidenceDebate society evenings for big ideas and bold voicesKaraoke, talent shows and fashion workshopsVisits to museums, galleries, the Covered Market and WestgateFriendly welcome activities to help everyone settle in quickly

description_short: Study History, Philosophy & Literature at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 16–18—creative projects, expert tutors & an inspiring Oxford setting.
description_full: Study History, Philosophy & Literature at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 16–18—creative projects, expert tutors & an inspiring Oxford setting.

curriculum_sections.body: Why Attend a History, Philosophy & Literature Summer School? From ancient philosophy to modern literature, explore the big ideas and timeless works that influence how we live today. Discuss and debate the big ideas, sharpening your skills through debates and assignments to write with impact and speak with confidence. Step Into the World of History, Philosophy & Literature Hone critical thinking and persuasive argumentation to express and defend ideas with clarity and confidence. Explore Oxford’s publishing legacy at the OUP Museum and uncover five centuries of influence, then dive into the Ashmolean’s collections to discover art across cultures and eras: connecting ideas, history and creative practice.Group Research & PresentationsDaily Hands-On ProjectsEngaging Expert TeachersBuild Skills for Dynamic CareersAcademic Showcase projectAshmolean Museum TourExplore History’s Defining Moments Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. curriculum_sections.title: Why this program
curriculum_sections.body: The Leaders of Tomorrow Start Here The future will be led by those who understand technology and know how to harness it responsibly. This programme is designed for ambitious students ready to lead in an AI-driven world, combining innovation, entrepreneurship and real-world problem-solving. Delivered by MIT-affiliated instructors, the experience blends hands-on learning with cutting-edge insight into the technologies shaping tomorrow. On completion, students are awarded an MIT RAISE Certificate, marking their participation in a globally recognised programme built to prepare leaders for what lies ahead. Step Into the World of Artificial Intelligence & Innovation Step into the world of modern business, moving from concept to company as you explore entrepreneurship, leadership and global market trends. Tackle real-world challenges, analyse how AI and technology reshape industries and collaborate with inspiring peers.Hands-on Coding SessionsInteractive Workshops on AITeam-based Learning ExperienceApp & Advanced Technologies ProjectsInnovation DemoPitch Your Ideas at the Innovation DemoLearn from MIT ExpertsGraduate with an Official MIT RAISE Certificate 6:1 student-teacher ratio From unforgettable moments to lasting inspirations - discover the Oxford Royale Experience Our Summer School brings together students from around the world to study in the heart of Oxford. In this highlights film, you'll hear first-hand how the blend of inspiring lessons, historic venues and new friendships create a truly life-changing experience. Enrol Now Learn from MIT Experts & Mentors From your day to day teacher to the mentors guiding you, you'll be learning from MIT RAISE instructors who can challenge, inspire and personalise your learning experience. This is a unique opportunity to learn from the very best. Take a look at some of the previous MIT FutureBuilders instructors. Students will also learn from mentors, exceptional MIT students who will inspire your journey. Previous slideNext slideErdin BeshimovMIT LecturerA Lecturer at MIT and a Senior Director of Experiential Learning at MIT Open Learning, Erdin Beshimov is committed to creating new pathways for learners worldwide to study innovation, technology and entrepreneurship. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an MIT RAISE certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. This award is accredited by MIT RAISE, proof of your achievement with us this summer. Expert Teachers Learn from MIT affiliated experts in an immersive environment Leadership Roles Take on leadership roles every day and build your confidence Mentorship Regular feedback, pitch coaching and small class sizes Oxford: A City Shaped by Academic Excellence Explore a city defined by its historic colleges, famous libraries and lively student atmosphere. From open debates and independent bookshops to peaceful college quads and riverside walks, Oxford offers a truly immersive university experience. Trusted by parents and students alike Hear From Our Students“I have never been to Oxford before and now I love it. The buildings and the history are incredible. My favourite part has been the people. I have met so many people from all over the world and I have made some lifelong friends. ”LauraBusiness, Innovation & EntrepreneurshipHear from Our Parents“The classes were very different from school. We had the hands-on experiences that are really important for learning the subject and it’s helped me decide what I want to do in the future. ”MariaEngineering“I chose to come to Oxford Royale because I wanted an adventure! I also wanted to explore university life and learn more about the subject. I love the lessons here because the teachers make the lessons fun while teaching, lots of practical work.”FemiExplore Engineering“In school, we mostly learn simpler topics, but these classes were different. Study anatomy, diagnosis and patient care, then practise your skills in simulations - with state of the art medical training equipment - designed to feel like the real thing. Medicine is more than memorising facts. Learn how to think critically, act decisively and care for patients through hands-on practice and teamwork. Step Into the World of Medicine Step into medicine by studying anatomy, physiology and diagnosis while practising real clinical skills in state-of-the-art simulations. Explore case studies, perform examinations and sharpen your decision-making through teamwork and hands-on training. curriculum_sections.body: Why Attend a Medicine Summer School? Want to step into medicine? Study anatomy, diagnosis and patient care, then practise your skills in simulations - with state of the art medical training equipment - designed to feel like the real thing. Medicine is more than memorising facts. Learn how to think critically, act decisively and care for patients through hands-on practice and teamwork. Step Into the World of Medicine Step into medicine by studying anatomy, physiology and diagnosis while practising real clinical skills in state-of-the-art simulations. Explore case studies, perform examinations and sharpen your decision-making through teamwork and hands-on training. Learn to think and act like a doctor as you master essential skills from CPR to suturing.Group Research & PresentationsDaily Hands-On ProjectsEngaging Expert TeachersBuild skills for Future Medical CareersDelve into Medical EthicsUnderstand Human AnatomyLearn from Case Studies and Simulations From unforgettable moments to lasting inspirations - discover the Oxford Royale Experience Our Summer School brings together students from around the world to study in the heart of Oxford. In this highlights film, you'll hear first hand how the blend of inspiring lessons, historic venues and new friendships create a truly life-changing experience. Enrol Now Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideDr Claire KeeneMSc, PhDDr Claire Keene is a public health clinician with a masters in International Health and Tropical Medicine from the University of Oxford. She is an experienced clinical trial manager, formerly managing a Médecins Sans Frontières project on HIV and tuberculosis. Dr Claire Keene MSc, PhD Dr Claire Keene is a public health clinician with a masters in International Health and Tropical Medicine from the University of Oxford. She is an experienced clinical trial manager, formerly managing a Médecins Sans Frontières project on HIV and tuberculosis. title: Sustainability & the Environment
subject: Sustainability
description_short: Study Sustainability and the Environment at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 16–18—creative projects, expert tutors & an inspiring Oxford setting.
description_full: Study Sustainability and the Environment at Oxford Royale’s summer school for ages 16–18—creative projects, expert tutors & an inspiring Oxford setting.

curriculum_sections.body: Why Attend a Sustainability & the Environment Summer School? Turn your commitment to the planet into real impact. Explore climate change, environmental policy, conservation and global leadership - all while solving real sustainability challenges through debates, case studies and collaborative projects with passionate peers from around the world. Step into the World of Sustainability Turn your passion for the planet into action by studying climate change, policy and leadership while tackling real challenges through case studies, debates and projects. Build climate-conscious leadership skills, explore conservation methods and step into global diplomacy through a UN Mock Summit. Gain practical and academic tools for future high-impact careers.Group Research & Environmental PresentationsDaily Hands-On Sustainability ProjectsLearn From Climate & Conservation SpecialistsBuild Skills for Tomorrow’s Green EconomyLearn How Sustainable Businesses OperateExplore Careers in High-Impact Environmental SectorsMove Toward Global Environmental Leadership Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideBlanka HoligovaInternational Relations & DiplomacyDedicated lecturer in Politics with over 15 years of teaching experience across diverse educational settings. With a postgraduate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy, Blanka has a strong foundation in global politics, international affairs and diplomatic studies, which she integrates into her teaching to provide students with both theoretical understanding and real-world context. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Group Projects Develop your own Sustainability Accord, researching a real climate issue, proposing evidence-based solutions and presenting your findings as a delegate at a sustainability summit. Workshops Take on the role of a green professional, ecologist, engineer, sustainability consultant, or eco-artist, to collaboratively tackle a real-world environmental issue. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Trusted by parents and students alike Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Hear From Our Students“I have never been to Oxford before and now I love it. The buildings and the history are incredible. My favourite part has been the people. I have met so many people from all over the world and I have made some lifelong friends. ”LauraBusiness, Innovation & EntrepreneurshipHear from Our Parents“The classes were very different from school. We had the hands-on experiences that are really important for learning the subject and it’s helped me decide what I want to do in the future. ”MariaEngineering“I chose to come to Oxford Royale because I wanted an adventure! I also wanted to explore university life and learn more about the subject. I love the lessons here because the teachers make the lessons fun while teaching, lots of practical work.”FemiExplore Engineering“In school, we mostly learn simpler topics, but these classes were different. The lessons went much more in depth and I found them fascinating. If this is what university-level learning is like, I definitely want to go to university. I’ve really enjoyed the experience and I hope university will be just like this.”NicolasExperimental PsychologyPrevious slideNext slide Make connections to last a lifetime Our social programme is all about connection, creativity and giving students space to try new things. description_short: Study like a real Ivy League student is Oxford Royale. Live at Yale, visit Harvard and spend a full week at Barnard College, Columbia University in NYC. ●
description_full: Study like a real Ivy League student is Oxford Royale. Live at Yale, visit Harvard and spend a full week at Barnard College, Columbia University in NYC. ●

curriculum_sections.body: Experience the Ivy League like never before This summer, join a select group of scholars following in the footsteps of presidents, pioneers and Nobel Laureates, as you study and immerse yourself in academic life at three of the world’s most renowned Ivy League universities.Step into campus life amid Yale’s historic ivy-covered courtyards and Columbia’s dynamic city energy. Plus the opportunity to explore Cambridge, Massachusetts, the historic university town which is home to Harvard University. Study Leadership Where Leaders Are Made Begin with private leadership seminars at Yale in politics, philosophy and economics. Explore the historic academic centre of Harvard, then turn insight into impact at Columbia through practical workshops and curated visits to the United Nations and New York landmarks. Far more than a taste of Ivy League life, this crafted programme gives a true understanding of what it means to study in these iconic institutions and inspires a vision for your own future path.Lectures, workshops & case studies in Global LeadershipYale faculty visits and fascinating talks from faculty staffSharpen critical thinking skills with debate workshopsGuided tours of Harvard, Columbia and Yale Curated visits to the United Nations, the Met and Natural History MuseumImmerse yourself in New York visiting landmarks and a cruise on the Hudson RiverEnjoy Wicked on Broadway plus private workshop with producer discussing financing a multi-million-dollar production Download the brochure Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideTamy-Feé MeneideIvy League Admissions SpeakerTamy-Feé is an educational consultant, mentorship strategist and experienced academic speaker with a decade of guiding students through their higher education journeys. Drawing on her extensive background in university settings, including past admissions experience at MIT and Dartmouth and degrees from Boston College, she specializes in helping students discover their authentic academic voice and articulate their unique educational narratives. She is dedicated to helping young scholars translate their personal and academic experiences into compelling, confident reflections that stand out, ensuring they are fully prepared to take their next steps toward higher education with clarity and purpose. Tamy-Feé Meneide Ivy League Admissions Speaker Tamy-Feé is an educational consultant, mentorship strategist and experienced academic speaker with a decade of guiding students through their higher education journeys. Drawing on her extensive background in university settings, including past admissions experience at MIT and Dartmouth and degrees from Boston College, she specializes in helping students discover their authentic academic voice and articulate their unique educational narratives. She is dedicated to helping young scholars translate their personal and academic experiences into compelling, confident reflections that stand out, ensuring they are fully prepared to take their next steps toward higher education with clarity and purpose. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. How You'll Learn Explore the world's best Ivy League universities, visit leading global companies and soak up the art, culture and excitement of New York in one unforgettable summer Faculty Visits Exclusive academic access: schools & departments at Yale and Columbia Wicked the Musical - with Behind the Scenes Workshop In the morning, students attend an exclusive Broadway Bound Workshop with a professional producer to deconstruct the high-stakes financing and management of a multi-million-dollar production. The day culminates in the evening with a performance of the global phenomenon Wicked, allowing the cohort to witness the spectacular result of that strategic leadership in action. Exclusive Guest Speakers Virtual Admissions Workshop: Tamy-Feé MeneideWith admissions experience from both MIT and Dartmouth, Tamy-Feé is an educational consultant and admissions strategist with a background in higher education and over a decade of experience guiding students through highly selective admissions processes.Live Admissions Workshop: Dr. Sergey R, Ivy League Admissions ExpertDr. Sergey R has helped students gain admission to Stanford, Princeton, Brown, Cornell, NYU, UC Berkeley, UChicago and more.Psychology-Focused Session: Monroe EgbuchunamMonroe Egbuchunam is social media UX researcher in cognitive psychology, HCI and algorithmic bias studying marginalized users’ experiences with digital platforms and AI. Graduation Celebrate the end of your course in style at your Oxford Royale graduation. Have the chance to dress in your best clothes and receive a certificate that showcases all your hard work during the course, joined with the new friends you’ve made. Trusted by parents and students alike From the first day to the last, our students discover the best version of themselves. Read their stories and see why Oxford Royale leaves a mark that lasts a lifetime. Hear from our students“In school, we mostly learn simpler topics, but these classes were different. The lessons went much more in depth and I found them fascinating. If this is what university-level learning is like, I definitely want to go to university. I've really enjoyed this experience and I hope university will be just like this.”NicolasExperimental PsychologyHear from our parents“I have never been to Oxford before and now I love it. The buildings and the history are incredible. My favourite part has been the people. I have met so many people from all over the world and I have made some lifelong friends.”LauraBusiness“I wanted to explore university life and learn more about my subject. I loved the lessons here because the teachers make the lessons engaging and we take part in practical work all linked to the course. ”FemiEngineeringPrevious slideNext slide Immerse yourself in three unforgettable locations Experience the best of the East Coast in one unforgettable journey.Go behind the scenes at Yale with insider tours, the Peabody Museum and the School of Management and discover what makes New Haven unique.Dive into New York’s energy with a guided Met visit, Central Park tours, K-Town nights and an exclusive Wicked performance with a behind-the-scenes workshop.Then head to Cambridge, Massachusetts for a must-see Harvard experience: student-led campus tour, student panel insights and a guest lecture. Make lasting connections Social life is lively, creative and full of inspiration. From journalism and debate clubs to evenings discovering the city, students connect through unforgettable shared experiences in a setting that invites curiosity, expression and big conversations.Journalism club exploring storytelling and media skillsDebate society sessions for confident, thoughtful discussionGroup outings to galleries, parks and neighbourhood hotspotsWelcome activities to help everyone settle in fastEvenings discovering local cafés, culture and creative corners

title: Law & Trial Advocacy Academy
subject: Law
description_short: Study Law & Trial Advocacy at Oxford Royale’s summer school in Yale for ages 16–18—creative projects, supportive tutors & an inspiring university setting.
description_full: Study Law & Trial Advocacy at Oxford Royale’s summer school in Yale for ages 16–18—creative projects, supportive tutors & an inspiring university setting.

curriculum_sections.body: Why attend a Law Summer School? Step into the shoes of a lawyer and experience the exciting world of law, justice and advocacy. This course offers a unique combination of academic exploration and courtroom simulation, giving you a head start in understanding legal systems and sharpening your skills in argumentation and critical thinking.Studying law on campus with Oxford Royale at Yale University places you within one of the most influential legal and academic environments in the world. Renowned for its intellectual rigour and tradition of public service, Yale fosters critical thinking, debate and a deep understanding of how law shapes society.Immersed in this inspiring setting, you explore key legal principles while experiencing campus life at an institution long associated with leadership, global impact and excellence in legal scholarship. Step Into the World of Law Explore the world of law through hands-on advocacy. Build foundations in constitutional, criminal and human rights law, analyse real cases and practice crafting arguments, questioning witnesses and presenting confidently in simulated trials and debates.Foundations Of Key Legal FieldsDaily Hands-On ProjectsEngaging Expert TeachersTwo Mock TrialsReal Case Study AnalysisPublic Speaking and Debate SkillsVisit the Yale Law Library, with specialist PhD guide Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideYusuf OlalereMScYusuf is an Associate in the Corporate Practice, working from London while supporting the New York team. He holds an MSc in Law & Finance from the University of Oxford, giving him a strong interdisciplinary grounding in both legal and financial aspects of complex corporate transactions. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Group Projects Act as a team of junior attorneys preparing a case briefing on a major area of U.S. law; researching landmark cases, explaining legal principles clearly and presenting to an audience of peers and stakeholders. Workshops Hands-on classes designed to help students learn through practical application. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Yale: Experience the Ivy League Tradition Explore the historic campus and vibrant cultural scene of New Haven, a city known for its arts, architecture and academic heritage. With striking Gothic buildings, renowned museums and a close-knit student atmosphere, Yale offers a distinctive Ivy League experience. Visit Yale Faculties Experience the buzz of academic life and explore Yale University’s renowned faculties, stepping into the spaces where groundbreaking ideas continue to be developed and a legacy of leadership has shaped global history for over three centuries! You will have the opportunity to see areas such as the Yale School of Management, the Yale Law Library and the Center for Engineering Innovation and Design (CEID). Friday Night Party Nothing captures the quintessential "American College Experience" like a high-energy Friday night social, where the campus transforms into a vibrant hub of music, dancing and school spirit. This exclusive event provides the perfect atmosphere for students to unwind after a week of elite academics, fostering lifelong international friendships and unforgettable memories in the heart of a storied Ivy League setting. Graduation Celebrate the end of your course in style at your Oxford Royale graduation. Have the chance to dress in your best clothes and receive a certificate that showcases all your hard work during the course, joined with the new friends you’ve made. Make connections to last a lifetime Our social timetable is all about allowing students to make new friends and explore new ventures, surrounded by their historic setting. Students can expect creative workshops, group outings, relaxed welcome events and trips exploring local culture in this atmospheric college town.Creative workshops that spark collaboration and fresh ideasGroup outings to museums, galleries and Yale facultyWelcome activities that help everyone connect from day oneJournalism club, Debate society and grand final

title: Medicine in Yale
subject: Medicine
description_short: Study Medicine at Oxford Royale’s summer school in Yale for ages 16–18—creative projects, supportive tutors & an inspiring university setting.
description_full: Study Medicine at Oxford Royale’s summer school in Yale for ages 16–18—creative projects, supportive tutors & an inspiring university setting.

curriculum_sections.body: Why attend a Medicine Summer School? Discover the world of modern medicine through hands-on practicals, workshops and simulations. Explore biology, genetics, neuroscience, genomics, emergency medicine and anatomy while gaining insight into careers as a Doctor or medical researcher.Studying medicine on campus with Oxford Royale at Yale offers the opportunity to experience learning in one of the world’s most prestigious academic environments. Our programme places you in a historic centre of medical scholarship and scientific discovery, where innovation and research have shaped modern healthcare for generations. Step Into the World of Medicine Want to step into medicine? Study anatomy, diagnosis and patient care, then practise your skills in simulations - with state of the art medical training equipment - designed to feel like the real thing. Medicine is more than memorising facts. Learn how to think critically, act decisively and care for patients through hands-on practice and teamwork.Daily Hands-On ProjectsEngaging Expert TeachersBuild skills for future medical careerDelve into medical ethicsClinical skills practical workshop Download the course guide Explore the different modules and understand the skills, knowledge and confidence you will gain from this course. EmailSubmit What will your course look like Find out more about the lessons, academic enrichment and extracurriculars you will enjoy with Oxford Royale View Sample Timetable Learn from true subject experts Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Find out more Previous slideNext slideDr Claire KeeneMSc, PhDDr Claire Keene is a public health clinician with a masters in International Health and Tropical Medicine from the University of Oxford. She is an experienced clinical trial manager, formerly managing a Médecins Sans Frontières project on HIV and tuberculosis. Dr Claire Keene MSc, PhD Dr Claire Keene is a public health clinician with a masters in International Health and Tropical Medicine from the University of Oxford. She is an experienced clinical trial manager, formerly managing a Médecins Sans Frontières project on HIV and tuberculosis. From achievement to recognition - graduate with an Oxford Royale certificate of completion Awarded upon successful completion of your programme, this is a certificate that recognises your academic engagement and commitment. It records your course titles, dates and campus and is signed by the Oxford Royale leadership team. Group Projects Take on a real clinical skills assessment; taking a patient's history, outlining an examination and presenting a diagnosis and management plan under exam conditions. Workshops Hands-on classes designed to help students learn through practical application. How You'll Learn Escape ordinary classroom teaching and learn through interactive and immersive lessons. Debates Essential for honing students' reasoning abilities and public speaking skills. Yale: Experience the Ivy League Tradition Explore the historic campus and vibrant cultural scene of New Haven, a city known for its arts, architecture and academic heritage. With striking Gothic buildings, renowned museums and a close-knit student atmosphere, Yale offers a distinctive Ivy League experience. Visit Yale Faculties Experience the buzz of academic life and explore Yale University’s renowned faculties, stepping into the spaces where groundbreaking ideas continue to be developed and a legacy of leadership has shaped global history for over three centuries! You will have the opportunity to see areas such as the Yale School of Management, the Yale Law Library and the Center for Engineering Innovation and Design (CEID). Friday Night Party Nothing captures the quintessential "American College Experience" like a high-energy Friday night social, where the campus transforms into a vibrant hub of music, dancing and school spirit. This exclusive event provides the perfect atmosphere for students to unwind after a week of elite academics, fostering lifelong international friendships and unforgettable memories in the heart of a storied Ivy League setting. Graduation Celebrate the end of your course in style at your Oxford Royale graduation. Have the chance to dress in your best clothes and receive a certificate that showcases all your hard work during the course, joined with the new friends you’ve made. Trusted by parents and students alike Unlike other summer programmes, our curriculum is developed by academic experts who draw from their wealth of experience, crafting programmes that allow students to grasp the core concepts of their field of study and enlighten them to the current issues and innovations shaping the future of their subject. Hear From Our Students“The classes were very different from school. We had the hands-on experiences that are really important for learning the subject and it’s helped me decide what I want to do in the future. ”MariaEngineeringHear from Our Parents“I chose to come to Oxford Royale because I wanted an adventure! I also wanted to explore university life and learn more about the subject. I love the lessons here because the teachers make the lessons fun while teaching, lots of practical work.”FemiExplore Engineering“In school, we mostly learn simpler topics, but these classes were different. The lessons went much more in depth and I found them fascinating. If this is what university-level learning is like, I definitely want to go to university. I’ve really enjoyed the experience and I hope university will be just like this.”NicolasExperimental PsychologyPrevious slideNext slide Make connections to last a lifetime Our social timetable is all about allowing students to make new friends and explore new ventures, surrounded by their historic setting. Students can expect creative workshops, group outings, relaxed welcome events and trips exploring local culture in this atmospheric college town.Creative workshops that spark collaboration and fresh ideasGroup outings to museums, galleries and Yale facultyWelcome activities that help everyone connect from day oneJournalism club, Debate society and grand final

curriculum_sections.body: Why attend an Economics & Finance Summer School? Understand how economies work and why money moves. Study markets, investment and global finance, then apply your knowledge in real-world projects. Learn to think like an economist and act like a strategist. Step Into Finance and Economics Explore the world of economics and finance through hands-on learning. Build core foundations in micro and macroeconomics, markets and investment, tackle real-world business and policy challenges and practise analysing data, testing strategies and responding to shifting global trends through simulations and case studies.Begin at Yale University, where historic tradition meets cutting-edge economic theory, before transitioning to Barnard College, Columbia University, in the heart of Manhattan. title: Active English
subject: Active English
description_short: Grow in confidence in all four English language skills (speaking, listening, reading, writing) and learn outside the classroom with visits to places of cultural and historical interest in Oxford and beyond.
description_full: Grow in confidence in all four English language skills (speaking, listening, reading, writing) and learn outside the classroom with visits to places of cultural and historical interest in Oxford and beyond.

curriculum_sections.title: Course benefits
curriculum_sections.body: 1. Supportive environment with a high staff-to-student ratio Benefit from a supportive classroom environment and strong pastoral care. Our caring staff help you thrive during your time here and our friendly team of residential activity leaders lead an action-packed programme and accompany you on excursions.. 2. Specialist English language teaching Develop your English language skills with our professional and qualified English teachers and learn with your peers in split classes between those aged 9-12 and 13-15. 3. Interactive learning Language teaching focuses on topical Weekly Themes. The weekly excursions are a mix of historical, cultural and fun activities which students are introduced to in the classroom before their visit. 4. Gain a rich cultural experience Visit cultural and historical locations in Oxford and places nearby like London, Bath and Windsor Castle. 5. International atmosphere We cultivate an international atmosphere, welcoming students from around the world who enjoy living and learning together. 6. Enjoyable study visits, activities and excursions Discover Oxford and the UK, with up to 3 excursions per week. Our programme also includes activities such as arts and crafts, quizzes, sports, a disco, talent shows and much more. 7. Attractive and safe campus Our study environment is a secure residential campus with a range of facilities and beautiful open spaces. 8. Learn in a global city Oxford is a world-famous academic city. It is a multicultural city with a rich heritage and has lots to see and do. LEO CHINA, ACTIVE ENGLISH 2023 " I would definitely recommend St Clare’s because the environment here is very good and the teachers are friendly and kind. The lessons are really fun, it doesn’t feel like school, it’s just like another family! ” Course Structure Grow in confidence in all four English language skills (speaking, listening, reading, writing) and learn outside the classroom with visits to places of cultural and historical interest in Oxford and beyond. Afternoon Electives Choose 1 option per week: Football Coaching Improve your football skills with our professional Football Association qualified coaches Tennis Coaching Enhance your tennis skills with coaching from professional LTA qualified coaches Performing Arts Enjoy workshops with qualified and experienced coaches to develop skills in a range of performing arts including acting, dance, public speaking and improvisation. Performing Arts Discover the world of performance through our engaging Performing Arts elective, delivered by Abie Walton from The North Wall Theatre in Summertown as part of our exciting partnership with the theatre. Open to all students on the Junior programme, this six-hour-per-week elective requires no previous experience or language ability - just enthusiasm and a willingness to get involved. Through a varied programme of improvisation, character exploration and devising physical theatre, students can join for one week or several, developing valuable skills in teamwork, voice and articulation, personal presentation, public speaking and thinking on their feet. Our partnership with The North Wall also provides unique opportunities beyond the classroom, including hosting participants from their ArtsLab programme, gallery visits and artist talks and the use of the theatre by our IB students for their end-of-year performance.

title: Active English + STEM
subject: Active English + STEM
description_short: Build in all four English language skills while exploring the exciting world of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Maths).
description_full: Build in all four English language skills while exploring the exciting world of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Maths).

curriculum_sections.title: Course benefits
curriculum_sections.body: Combine English with STEM Build all four English language skills while exploring the exciting world of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Maths) and learn with your peers in split classes between those aged 9-12 and 13-15. Hands-On Learning Take part in practical challenges and workshops that will help you build your skills in STEM. From coding and construction to fun and engaging science and maths sessions at our IB World School, you’ll have many chances to learn new ideas and put them into practice. Learn from Specialists Benefit from STEM teaching, with expert staff guiding you through interactive and project-based learning. Explore Oxford’s Academic Heritage Study in one of the world’s most famous academic cities, home to the University of Oxford, with visits that connect classroom learning to real-world innovation. Boost Confidence in English STEM projects are taught through English, helping you develop subject vocabulary and strengthen communication skills in authentic contexts. Work in Teams Collaborate with classmates from around the world on exciting group projects – just like real scientists and engineers. Future-Focused Experience Gain early exposure to STEM subjects in an international setting, preparing you for future studies and inspiring a passion for discovery. All the Benefits of Junior Programmes Enjoy the same safe campus, supportive staff, comfortable accommodation, international community and action-packed activities and excursions programme as our other junior courses. LEO CHINA, ACTIVE ENGLISH 2023 " I would definitely recommend St Clare’s because the environment here is very good and the teachers are friendly and kind. The lessons are really fun, it doesn’t feel like school, it’s just like another family! ” Course Structure Build in all four English language skills while exploring the exciting world of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Maths). Combine language learning with innovation and discovery, through coding workshops, hands-on engineering challenges and maths and science workshops at our IB World School.

title: Art & Digital Design
subject: Art & Digital Design
description_short: Explore and develop creative art and digital design techniques in our purpose-built art studio complete with dark room, printing press and a wide range of resources. Be inspired by Oxford’s historical and contemporary architecture, museums and art galleries. Showcase learning through the creation of artwork for an exhibition.
description_full: Explore and develop creative art and digital design techniques in our purpose-built art studio complete with dark room, printing press and a wide range of resources. Be inspired by Oxford’s historical and contemporary architecture, museums and art galleries. Showcase learning through the creation of artwork for an exhibition.

curriculum_sections.title: Course benefits
curriculum_sections.body: Guidance from experienced teachers Learn from professional artists and art teachers who provide personalised support to help you develop your creative style and technical skills. State-of-the-Art Studio Spaces Work in our modern, fully equipped art studio with access to a wide range of resources and tools. Explore a Range of Techniques Experiment with a variety of techniques and media, giving you the freedom to explore, innovate and discover your own unique approach. Inspirational Study Visits Gain inspiration from visits to Oxford’s museums and galleries, drawing on both historical and contemporary art for your own projects. Collaborate with Practising Artists Meet and learn from local professional artists, gaining insight into their creative process and the art world beyond the classroom. Showcase Your Work Create a portfolio of your work and present it at an exhibition at the end of your course. With guidance and feedback from experienced art tutors, you’ll develop a portfolio that showcases your skills and creativity for future university applications or career opportunities. Time to Create, Reflect & Grow Enjoy free time in the studio that will allow you to develop ideas, experiment and reflect, producing meaningful and original artwork. Supportive and Diverse Environment Learn in a safe, welcoming setting alongside classmates from around the world, building cultural awareness and lifelong friendships. ANA BRAZIL, ART & DIGITAL DESIGN 2022 " This course really helped me to be sure of what I want for my future and also put me into this world of art, helping me to see how things work.” Explore and develop creative art and digital design techniques in our purpose-built art studio complete with dark room, printing press and a wide range of resources. Be inspired by Oxford’s historical and contemporary architecture, museums and art galleries. Showcase learning through the creation of artwork for an exhibition. Studio-time: You will be able to dedicate whole mornings or afternoons to work on your projects whilst benefiting from the advice and guidance of our teachers. New techniques: You will have the opportunity to learn and develop a wide range of artistic techniques including: darkroom and digital photographing, editing and displaying 2D drawing, painting, printmaking, illustrating, designing and exhibiting 3D textiles, fashion and casting Exhibition You will work towards the final Friday when you will present your work at an exhibition for your classmates. Study Visits and Guest Speakers Find inspiration in local art galleries and museums, with study visits including the Ashmolean Museum, the Museum of Modern Art Oxford and the North Wall Gallery. Careers Advice Session Our Art & Digital Design course includes a dedicated Careers Advice session, where students meet with our experienced University and Career Counsellors to explore future pathways, university options and career opportunities. This guidance helps students make informed decisions and plan their next steps with confidence. Modern Art Oxford Our Art & Digital Design course also includes a unique relationship with Modern Art Oxford. Students take part in curator-led tours of current exhibitions, hearing directly from the team behind the shows about the decisions that shaped them and having the opportunity to put their own questions to professionals working in the field. On the final exhibition day, a member of the Modern Art Oxford team joins the judging panel to offer students expert, industry-informed feedback on their own work. This connection to the professional art world gives students a genuine insight into creative careers and the transferable skills that underpin them. COURSE STRUCTURE DISCOVER

title: Business & Entrepreneurship
subject: Business & Entrepreneurship
description_short: Explore business studies and entrepreneurship while building your confidence and fluency in Business English. Put your entrepreneurial skills into action by creating and pitching your very own business plan.
description_full: Explore business studies and entrepreneurship while building your confidence and fluency in Business English. Put your entrepreneurial skills into action by creating and pitching your very own business plan.

curriculum_sections.title: Course benefits
curriculum_sections.body: Business Theory and Practice Follow the journey of a business idea, from first concept to final launch. Learn how to develop a product, create a budget, develop a marketing strategy and present your idea - just like an entrepreneur! Build Confidence in Business English Improve your fluency and vocabulary in Business English, while developing the language skills you need for academic and professional success and practise your persuasive presentation skills. Real-World Business Insights Benefit from Guest Speakers and Study Visits to local enterprises in Oxford, gaining first-hand exposure to professional business settings. Creative Business Project Turn knowledge into practice by developing an innovative business idea and pitching your own business plan to a panel. Small Class Sizes & Dedicated Support With a maximum of 12 students per class, you’ll receive close guidance, personal feedback and support from experienced teachers. International Environment Study in a global community, work in an international team and begin building your own international business network. Careers Advice & Future Pathways Take part in a careers advice session, helping you explore your higher education and career options in business and understand the next steps to achieve your goals. Study in an Inspiring Location Oxford’s history, architecture and global reputation for innovation provide a unique and motivating environment for your studies. BEATRIZ BRAZIL, BUSINESS & ENTREPRENEURSHIP 2022 " We discuss really important subjects. We had great lessons about globalisation, leadership, the workplace, the education system and I think it was very constructive for my career. ” Explore business studies and entrepreneurship while building your confidence and fluency in Business English. Put your entrepreneurial skills into action by creating and pitching your very own business plan. Study Visits and Guest Speakers Being based in the academic city of Oxford gives students access to an exciting programme of Guest Speakers and Study Visits. Recent speakers include local serial entrepreneur Ani Haykumi (MBA Oxon, CEO of Vann, a Healthtech company backed by Oxford University Innovation), Dr Tom Crawford (PhD Applied Mathematics, Cambridge), Christian Adofo (Nike Journalist & Brand Creative Writer) and Dr Marcus Nyman (Senior Policy Officer, RSPB; PhD Geography, Cambridge). Study visits have taken students to the Mini BMW Plant and into Oxford to undertake market research, offering rich learning beyond the classroom. Careers Advice Session Our Business & Entrepreneurship course includes a dedicated Careers Advice session, where students meet with our experienced University and Career Counsellors to explore future pathways, university options and career opportunities. This guidance helps students make informed decisions and plan their next steps with confidence. COURSE STRUCTURE DISCOVER

title: IB Introduction
subject: IB Introduction
description_short: Explore the IB philosophy and methodology while sampling classes in Literature, Language, Maths, Theatre, Humanities, Science and Theory of Knowledge.
description_full: Explore the IB philosophy and methodology while sampling classes in Literature, Language, Maths, Theatre, Humanities, Science and Theory of Knowledge.

curriculum_sections.title: Course benefits
curriculum_sections.body: IB Methodology Understand the IB philosophy and methodology, laying a strong foundation for future IB Diploma success. Excellent Preparation for the IB Diploma Gain subject knowledge and skills across English Literature, English Language, Maths, Performing Arts, Humanities, Science and the ‘Theory of Knowledge’ - aligned with the IB Diploma curriculum. Specialist IB Teaching Learn from highly experienced IB teachers at England’s longest established IB World School, with 50 years of expertise. Critical Thinking Discover the Theory of Knowledge (TOK), developing essential skills in critical thinking, analysis and international mindedness. Hands-On Learning & Study Visits Enhance classroom learning with engaging Study Visits, such as to Bletchley Park and the Shakespeare Open-Air Theatre, connecting theory with real-world academic and cultural experiences. Collaborative Projects Work in small teams on a subject-based project, developing teamwork, problem-solving and cross-cultural understanding. Small Class Sizes & Supportive Environment With a maximum of 12 students per class, you’ll benefit from personalised support and close interaction with subject specialists. Beyond the Classroom Enrich your experience with sports, cultural and social activities and excursions and a careers advice session to guide your academic journey. EMA ARGENTINA, IB INTRODUCTION 2022 "I love the creativity in which the lessons are given, the teaching style is very dynamic. The teachers are very nice and they make sure everyone understands.” Explore the IB philosophy and methodology while sampling classes in Literature, Language, Maths, Theatre, Humanities, Science and Theory of Knowledge. Apply multi-disciplinary learning through an in-depth study of Shakespeare across history, literature and the performing arts. Study Visits and Guest Speakers Being based in the academic city of Oxford gives students access to an exciting programme of Guest Speakers and Study Visits. Recent speakers include Dr Tom Crawford (PhD Applied Mathematics, Cambridge), Christian Adofo (Nike Journalist & Brand Creative Writer) and Dr Marcus Nyman (Senior Policy Officer, RSPB; PhD Geography, Cambridge). Study visits have taken students to the Bletchley Park, a Shakespeare play at the Open-Air Theatre and Christchurch College, offering rich learning beyond the classroom. Careers Advice Session Our IB Introduction course includes a dedicated Careers Advice session, where students meet with our experienced University and Career Counsellors to explore future pathways, university options and career opportunities. This guidance helps students make informed decisions and plan their next steps with confidence. COURSE STRUCTURE DISCOVER More

title: Intensive English Exam Prep
subject: Intensive English Exam Prep
description_short: Improve your chances of success and prepare for your IELTS or Cambridge English examinations by learning exam tips, practising exam techniques and developing academic study skills.
description_full: Improve your chances of success and prepare for your IELTS or Cambridge English examinations by learning exam tips, practising exam techniques and developing academic study skills.

curriculum_sections.title: Course benefits
curriculum_sections.body: Develop Confiedence in Exams Build exam skills for IELTS or the Cambridge English exams, with focused tips, exam practice and develop strategies to maximise your performance. Prepare for Academic Study Strengthen essential skills – critical thinking, essay writing, research, presentations and debate – that will support your future studies. Personal Research Project Work independently on a project that develops your research skills and prepares you for the demands of higher education. Inspiring Guest Speakers and Guest Visits Learn beyond the classroom with visits to Oxford’s academic resources and talks from professionals who connect theory to real-world practice. Careers Advice Session Gain practical guidance from our University and Career counselling team on career pathways related to your course, helping you plan for your academic and professional future. Small Class Sizes & Quality Support Study in classes of up to 12 students, ensuring personalised feedback, encouragement and focused academic support. Learning Resources Take advantage of our library with access to a large collection of books, journals and newspapers spread across 4 storeys and browse through the resources handpicked by our librarian that are related to the weekly theme. More Than Just Studying Enjoy a balance of academics and fun, with sports, activities and excursions to London, cultural landmarks, heritage sites and theme parks. DOROTA POLAND, INTENSIVE ENGLISH 2022 " Having to speak English at St Clare’s, definitely helped me improve it. I learned many new idioms and specific English expressions during class which not only helped my speaking but also my writing. ” Improve your chances of success and prepare for your IELTS or Cambridge English examinations by learning exam tips, practising exam techniques and developing academic study skills. Study Visits and Guest Speakers Being based in the academic city of Oxford gives students access to an exciting programme of Guest Speakers and Study Visits. Recent speakers include Dr Tom Crawford (PhD Applied Mathematics, Cambridge), Christian Adofo (Nike Journalist & Brand Creative Writer) and Dr Marcus Nyman (Senior Policy Officer, RSPB; PhD Geography, Cambridge). Study visits have taken students to the Ashmolean Museum, North Wall Gallery and a local nature reserve, offering rich learning beyond the classroom. COURSE STRUCTURE DISCOVER

title: Project Eco-Innovation
subject: Project Eco-Innovation
duration: 1 week – can be added to selected courses
description_short: Where sustainability, creativity and entrepreneurship come together! In this one-week, multi-disciplinary programme, students from different courses collaborate to develop bold ideas for a greener world. You’ll research, design and present innovative, cost-effective eco-solutions to real-world challenges.
description_full: Where sustainability, creativity and entrepreneurship come together! In this one-week, multi-disciplinary programme, students from different courses collaborate to develop bold ideas for a greener world. You’ll research, design and present innovative, cost-effective eco-solutions to real-world challenges.

curriculum_sections.title: Course benefits
curriculum_sections.body: Sustainability Meets Creativity Combine environmental awareness, creative thinking and entrepreneurial skills to tackle real-world challenges. Multi-Disciplinary Collaboration: Work alongside students from other courses – IB Introduction, Business & Entrepreneurship, Science & Experiments and Art & Digital Design – to bring diverse perspectives to your project. Practical, Real-World Projects Research, design and present innovative, cost-effective eco-solutions, developing problem-solving and project management skills. Develop Entrepreneurial Skills Learn how to turn ideas into actionable plans, pitching projects with confidence and persuasive communication. Hands-On Learning Benefit from a high staff-to-student ratio, ensuring guidance, feedback and personal attention throughout the project. Build International Connections Collaborate with students from around the world, developing teamwork, cultural awareness and lasting international friendships. Flexible Add-On Option Enhance your summer experience by adding this one-week course to other courses, gaining extra skills while complementing your main programme. SONNY CANADA, SUMMER TEENAGERS 2024 " I like the fact that it's not like normal school. I really love that it's a lot more interactive and we get to speak freely. We just discuss everyone’s views, rather than just listen to someone speaking the whole time." Where sustainability, creativity and entrepreneurship come together! In this one-week, multi-disciplinary programme, students from different courses collaborate to develop bold ideas for a greener world. You’ll research, design and present innovative, cost-effective eco-solutions to real-world challenges. Study Visits and Guest Speakers Project Eco -Innovation will draw on the city of Oxford’s position as an innovator in the ecological world. Students will explore the heart of Oxford and examine how businesses and leaders are seeking to embrace and leverage eco positive approaches. COURSE STRUCTURE DISCOVER

title: Science & Experiments
subject: Science & Experiments
description_short: Develop practical investigative science skills using data logging machines and microscopes, explore the University of Oxford’s scienced-themed museums and learn about research methodology. Apply your knowledge by conducting a scientific research project and presenting your findings.
description_full: Develop practical investigative science skills using data logging machines and microscopes, explore the University of Oxford’s scienced-themed museums and learn about research methodology. Apply your knowledge by conducting a scientific research project and presenting your findings.

curriculum_sections.title: Course benefits
curriculum_sections.body: Focus on Core Sciences Explore key topics in Biology, Chemistry and Physics, developing both subject knowledge and scientific vocabulary in English. Prepare for Further Study Build the practical investigative skills you’ll need for future studies in science, supported by staff with international teaching experience. Learn in State-of-the-Art Laboratories Use specialist equipment such as data logging machines and microscopes in modern, fully equipped science labs. Gain Hands-On Laboratory Experience Master essential techniques: observation, measuring, controlling variables, recording results and evaluating conclusions. Meet Practising Scientists Be inspired by Guest Speakers who share their cutting-edge research and insights from the world of science. Stimulating Study Visits Connect classroom learning with real-world science through visits to Oxford’s Natural History Museum, Pitt Rivers Museum, History of Science Museum and the University of Oxford Botanical Gardens. Personal Research Project Investigate a topic of your choice, conduct experiments and present your findings – building critical research and presentation skills. Supportive Environment & Future Pathways Study in small, supportive classes with a high staff-to-student ratio, enjoy excursions and cultural activities and receive tailored careers advice to guide your next steps in science. POVILAS LITHUANIA, SCIENCE & EXPERIMENTS 2025 " We don't just learn, we also develop different research projects and experiments which is really exciting. ” Develop practical investigative science skills using data logging machines and microscopes, explore the University of Oxford’s scienced-themed museums and learn about research methodology. Apply your knowledge by conducting a scientific research project and presenting your findings. Study Visits and Guest Speakers Being based in the academic city of Oxford gives students access to an exciting programme of Guest Speakers and Study Visits. Recent speakers include Dr Tom Crawford (PhD Applied Mathematics, Cambridge), Christian Adofo (Nike Journalist & Brand Creative Writer) and Dr Marcus Nyman (Senior Policy Officer, RSPB; PhD Geography, Cambridge). Study visits have taken students to Oxford’s Natural History Museum, Pitt Rivers Museum, History of Science Museum and the University of Oxford Botanical Gardens, offering rich learning beyond the classroom. Careers Advice Session Our Science & Experiments course includes a dedicated Careers Advice session, where students meet with our experienced University and Career Counsellors to explore future pathways, university options and career opportunities in the sciences. This guidance helps students make informed decisions and plan their next steps with confidence. curriculum_sections.title: Course benefits
curriculum_sections.body: Develop Leadership Skills Build confidence, resilience and mindfulness while developing the critical thinking and leadership qualities needed for the future. Small Classes, Big Impact Enjoy the advantages of a small class size, with more individual support and chances to work closely with other students on projects. Support Every Step of the Way Enjoy 24/7 support from our friendly and caring team and our team of residential activity leaders lead an action-packed activities programme and accompany you on excursions. Study in Oxford Live and learn in the world-famous city of Oxford, with up to 3 excursions per week to cultural and historical landmarks across the UK.
